current.employee_description:
40Mn devices in India. India’s most active user base.
Building for health, wellness, community & lifestyle. Come make Noise with us.

I build consumer products where hardware, software and revenue meet.

At Noise (India’s #1 smartwatch brand, 40M+ users, Bose as strategic investor), I own product vision, strategy and the multi-year roadmap across a six-line portfolio. I lead a cross-functional org of ~35 across product management, design and engineering.

Portfolio
NoiseFit app: consumer subscription platform with millions of monthly active users. I own monetisation, retention and LTV, and I’m evolving it from a device companion into a connected-health platform with an AI health coach, challenges and community.

REP: premium fitness band, with sensors, firmware and app built as one hardware-software product. I led the upmarket repositioning and go-to-market.

Audio: earbuds, headphones and home audio on a unified companion app, driving ecosystem cross-sell.
Noise Junior: kids’ wearables for parent and child, built for safety and reliability first, then engagement.

Connect: in-house customer support platform. I launched an AI support agent for REP and closed the loop from tickets and reviews into the roadmap.

New categories: 0→1 connected-device and IoT products, taken from concept to launch.

Revenue & growth impact
- Subscription revenue up 29% in 3 months, driven by ARPU growth
- Free-to-paid conversion up 15% among new users
- Device protection revenue up 29%, with attach rate up ~1.8x
- Daily revenue from the day-60+ cohort up 8.6%, a long-term retention win

Operating model
- AI-native product development: PMs ship working prototypes before work reaches design or engineering
- ICP-led discovery, rigorous experimentation and metric-driven execution
- A business case and data model for every new product bet

We’re hiring for all these verticals & the new product lines coming up. 
Check our hiring posts for roles pertinent to you.

past.employer_linkedin_description: BYJU’S is a global ed-tech company, providing highly adaptive, engaging and effective learning solutions to more than 150 million students around the world. Founded in India in 2011, BYJU’S mission is to make high-quality learning accessible to students everywhere.The BYJU’S family of brands includes Disney-BYJU’S Early Learn, BYJU’S Future School, Epic!, Osmo, Tynker, Toppr and WhiteHat Jr, along with our beloved flagship product BYJU’S – The Learning App. Together, BYJU’S solutions support Pre-K – 12 education and a wide range of competitive exams. BYJU’S delivers a world-class learning experience with tools that sit at the cross-section of mobile, interactive content and personalized learning methodologies. BYJU’S geography-agnostic solutions and 12,000+ teachers make learning engaging, with visual and contextual programs that adapt to the unique learning style, skill level and pace of each student. In addition, we have innovative partnerships with some of the world’s leading companies, including Disney and Google, to drive engagement and help even more students become active and lifelong learners. BYJU’S is backed by blue-chip investors including the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Sequoia Capital, Bond Capital, Silver Lake, BlackRock, Sands Capital Management, Alkeon Capital Management, Sofina, Verlinvest, Tencent, Prosus (previously Naspers Ventures), CPPIB, General Atlantic, Tiger Global, Qatar Investment Authority, Owl Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Times Internet, Aarin Capital and IFC. Since 2017, we have completed more than 15 acquisitions, including companies in the U.S., UK, Austria, India and Singapore. A 2021 Time 100 Most Influential Company, BYJU’S is headquartered in India, with operations in more than 21 countries globally and learning programs in multiple languages. For additional information, please visit www.byjus.com.

With a focus on innovation and accessibility, Tata 1mg is redefining healthcare in India, ensuring that quality care is always within reach, wherever you are.

Dyson solves real-world problems and creates better products through the application of engineering, science, design and creativity. It is a family-owned, global technology company, founded by Sir James Dyson who remains at the helm alongside his son Jake. Since inventing the first cyclonic bagless vacuum cleaner, the DC01, Dyson has consistently invested in research and development to improve its products and technologies radically. Dyson offers products across a growing range of areas: floorcare, air purification, robotics, haircare including formulations, lighting, hand drying, and most recently audio. Dyson continues to expand into new areas.Today, Dyson sells products in more than 80 markets, has 450 Dyson stores worldwide and is available in all major technology and beauty retailers. Dyson has global headquarters in Singapore and major technology campuses in Singapore, the UK, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global team of engineers, scientists and software developers are focused on developing technology-enabled products which work better and which people love to use. Key areas of focus have included high-speed electric digital motors, sensing and vision systems, robotics, machine learning and aerodynamics. Beyond products, to encourage an inventive future, Dyson is also inspiring the next generation of engineers and inventors through the Dyson Institute of Engineering and Technology, the James Dyson Foundation and the James Dyson Award.  The Dyson family applies its problem-solving approach in other fields, and established Dyson Farming in 2012. It is one of the largest farming businesses in the UK, extending to 36,000 acres across Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire, Gloucestershire and Somerset. It is a family-owned enterprise unlike any other, focussed on long-term investment in British farming and the countryside to grow tasty and nutritious food.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Founded on December 11, 1961, IIMA quickly assumed leadership in management education in India and has maintained it ever since. It has grown into India's favorite management school. The benchmark in management education in the country, it attracts the best of students and faculty. Recruiters ranging from global investment banks to NGOs working with the poor harvest its graduates. Delighted, they keep coming back for more. It is not surprising that one-third of the CEOs in India had their introduction to professional management at IIMA.Ever since ranking of business schools started in India in the 1990s, IIMA has been occupying the top slots year after year irrespective of who does the ranking and what parameters they use. In the Asia-Pacific region, IIMA has been repeatedly ranked among the top five business schools. In global rankings, it has consistently found itself among the top hundred business schools. In 2008, IIMA became the first business school in India to receive the international accreditation, EQUIS (European Quality Improvement System) by European Foundation for Management Development. In 2010, the Financial Times of London ranked IIMA’s two-year PGP (Post-Graduate Programme) eighth globally among Masters in Management Programmes that do not insist on work experience for admission. The same agency ranked IIMA’s Post-Graduate Programme for Executives (PGPX-for students with work experience) 11th globally among MBA programmes in 2011.IIMA's alumni have created or joined a wide range of organizations in India, transformed them, and given several of them a global presence. Some of the alumni are providing leadership at the global operations of multinationals. Behind their extraordinary achievements is the sense of confidence that they acquire during the rigorous programme at the Institute. “If you can survive the PGP at IIMA, you can take on anything,” declare several alumni. As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.House rules: https://nes.tl/HouseRules

NTPC Limited is India’s largest integrated power utility, with the Group's installed capacity exceeding 91 GW as of FY 26, contributing nearly one-fourth of India’s total power generation. The company has been at the forefront of powering India’s growth and strengthening the nation’s energy security since its inception in 1975.Over the years, NTPC has evolved from a thermal power producer into a diversified energy major with interests spanning thermal, hydro, renewable and nuclear power, along with coal mining, power trading, energy storage, green hydrogen, e-mobility and other emerging energy solutions.Guided by its commitment to reliability, sustainability and innovation, NTPC is helping shape India’s energy transition while powering infinite possibilities for the nation. The company is targeting nearly 149 GW of installed capacity by 2032, including 60 GW from renewable energy sources.For more details, visit www.ntpc.co.in.

basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder @Noise | Tech-driven brand in wearables
basic_profile.summary:
With a real sense of the pulse of India, I along with my brother, Gaurav have led Noise to build India’s largest Bootstrapped D2C company which has established itself as India’s No. 1 Smartwatch brand. In a deeply funded ecosystem, we have curated playbooks for building successful bootstrapped companies and act as an inspiration for young aspiring entrepreneurs. 

As the Co-founder at Noise, I am spearheading design technology and business expansion and have a deep focus on people and culture building. My knack for creativity and eye for detail have enabled Noise to create some of the most exquisite smartwatches and connected lifestyle products. 

A prominent leader in the D2C space, I have been recently recognised as the Entrepreneur of the Year 2022 by Entrepreneur India, and DeviceNext. I have been featured by Forbes India, The Economic Times, Entrepreneur India, Financial Express, CNBC, and many more.

Our aim is to further strengthen the vision of Noise and make it a globally connected lifestyle brand putting India on the global map when it comes to quality consumer tech offerings. Under our leadership, Noise has maintained the highest market share among Indian smartwatch brands, cementing its position as India’s No. 1 smartwatch player for 9 quarters and is among the top 4 Smartwatch brands in the world.

basic_profile.name: Harish Mehta
basic_profile.headline: When mavericks collaborate, industry thrives! Learn more in my bestselling book ‘The Maverick Effect’ | Founder & EC @OnwardTech | 1st Elected Chairman at NASSCOM | Institution Builder – Mission 100 Million Jobs
basic_profile.summary:
Mr. Harish Mehta is a key institution builder behind India’s IT industry. He co-founded NASSCOM in 1988, was its first elected Chairman, and later served as Convener of NASSCOM’s Chairman’s Council.

Mr. Mehta is the award-winning author of the 2022 national bestseller 'The Maverick Effect'. A case study on the power of self-regulation inspired by the book,  has been accepted at Harvard. Its message continues to reach more people through paperback, Gujarati, Hindi and Marathi editions, and on Audible. The IMC Chamber of Commerce and Industry has instituted the Maverick Effect Awards under its annual Digital Innovation Awards. Mr. Mehta shares these ideas globally, spanning industry associations, educational institutes, leadership forums, global MNCs and NGOs.

In 1999, he brought Silicon Valley’s The Indus Entrepreneurs (TiE) to India to promote innovation-driven entrepreneurship; today, TiE India has 29 chapters nationwide.

Mr. Mehta’s entrepreneurial journey is embodied by the Onward Group of Companies. He served as Deputy Chairman and Managing Director of Onward Novell (1992–2005), a 50:50 JV between Onward Group and Novell Inc. Under his guidance, Onward Technologies evolved into a global engineering and digital services organization. Earlier, he was among the chief architects of the Hinditron–Digital (DEC) JV in India (1987).

He is a founding member of Infinity Ventures Fund, India’s first corporatized venture fund, and helped promote the Indian Angel Network (IAN) in Mumbai. Under the aegis of the G20/S20 process, he contributed to a self-regulatory corporate governance framework tailored to startups.

Building on decades of institution and ecosystem building, Mr. Mehta is also helping anchor the Mission Hundred Million Jobs initiative, a national effort bringing together industry, government and civil society to place job creation at the centre of India’s growth story amid AI-driven disruption and opportunity. Since being announced in January 2026, the mission has signed a 5-year MoU with the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation (RSLDC) to support the creation of 3.5 lakh jobs across Rajasthan through demand-linked skilling, enterprise participation, and district-level execution.

He also served as a Director at the College of Engineering, Pune (COEP) from 2010 to 2015 and was recognized as a Distinguished Alumnus in 1995. He holds a bachelor’s in electrical engineering from COEP and a master’s in computer science from NYU Tandon School of Engineering (formerly Brooklyn Polytechnic Institute).

current.employer_linkedin_description: SVP Science Fund (SSF) is a, principal led deep science investment platform, designed to build, own, and commercialize scientific and technological intellectual property across multiple strategic sectors. The fund is founded on the recognition of a structural gap in India, where strong scientific and engineering talent remains undercapitalized, under-commercialized, or lost to global markets. SSF addresses this by integrating capital, infrastructure, and execution into a unified platform that converts talent, research, innovation, and aspiration into scalable, revenue generating assets.SSF integrates multiple core pillars, including a world-class R&D and incubation ecosystem to translate research into market-aligned products, an IP warehouse to systematically build, own, and license molecules, processes, and scientific assets, a high-quality experiential skilling layer, and a dedicated agri-biotech vertical focused on developing high-yield, climate-resilient seeds and improving agricultural productivity in India. Together, these pillars enable a focused effort to reverse brain drain by attracting top Indian-origin scientific talent with capital, infrastructure, and execution capability.This model reduces go-to-market risk, accelerates commercialization, and enables cross-sector compounding of value. Positioned as an industrial-scale platform rather than a traditional fund, SSF combines capital, infrastructure, and scientific governance to build a portfolio of defensible, cash-generating assets, with the long-term objective of establishing India as a global hub for deep science innovation and a net exporter of high-value scientific IP.

basic_profile.name: Chintan Thakkar
basic_profile.headline: Group CEO IAN Group, Sr Managing Partner IAN Alpha Fund Backing Founders * Partnering with LPs & Angel Investors
basic_profile.summary: Great companies are built by exceptional founders. Great investment outcomes are built through patient capital, disciplined governance and trusted partnerships. After 12 years as Group CFO and Board Member of Info Edge—one of India’s leading listed technology companies, recognised for entrepreneurship, corporate governance and marquee investments—I now lead IAN Group as Group CEO and serve as Senior Managing Partner of IAN Alpha Fund.  I bring together operating leadership, public-market governance, capital markets expertise and venture investing to back founders building enduring companies, create long-term value for LPs, and enable angel investors to invest alongside exceptional entrepreneurs.  IAN combines one of India’s largest angel investor networks with a SEBI-registered venture capital fund, supporting entrepreneurs from inception through scale.  At Info Edge, I worked closely with founders and management teams through capital raises, M&A, governance challenges and business inflection points. During my tenure, the company grew nearly 20x in market capitalisation, from around ₹5,000 crore to over ₹1,00,000 crore by early 2025. I was closely involved in building category-leading businesses such as Naukri.com and 99acres.com and in developing Info Edge’s venture investment portfolio.  I played pivotal role in establishing the Info Edge Venture Fund and subsequently partnered with Temasek to scale it into an approximately US$450 million investment platform.  I had the privilege of being part of the journeys of companies such as Zomato and Policybazaar from early-stage investments to large listed companies.  I also led US$375 million of QIPs, strategic investments and M&A, and managed institutional investor relationships across multiple market cycles.  Earlier, I spent 15 years at CA Technologies helping establish India as a strategic hub for product engineering, the domestic market and partnerships with leading Indian system integrators, contributing to a significant large business footprint.  Today, my focus is on backing exceptional founders, building strong investor–founder partnerships and creating sustainable long-term value through disciplined venture investing and governance.Recognition: CFO of the Year 2023 – Financial Express (Large & Mid-Cap Category)

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zypp Electric is India’s Leading Tech-Enabled EV Rental platform, founded in 2017 with a Mission to achieve zero emissions and to make India carbon-free by using an ecosystem of Electric Vehicles and EV-based technology to make last-mile logistics sustainable and emission-free. Zypp Electric's business model is to make carbon-free last-mile delivery for local merchants to e-commerce giants to delivery executives and thereby reduce delivery cost and pollution on an asset-light model. The company currently delivers groceries, medicines, food, and e-commerce packages from point A to point B through their fully automated IoT and AI-enabled scooters, which are low on maintenance and high on performance. The technology tracks batteries that can be replaced at Zypp swapping stations which are installed at key touchpoints. Eco-friendly EV services also reduce the cost per delivery and help to make the city pollution-free.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Supreme Court of India is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India, the highest constitutional court, with the power of constitutional review. Consisting of the Chief Justice of India and 30 other judges, it has extensive powers in the form of original, appellate and advisory jurisdictions. As the final court of appeal of the country, it takes up appeals primarily against verdicts of the High Courts of various states of the Union and other courts and tribunals. It safeguards fundamental rights of citizens and settles disputes between various governments in the country. As an advisory court, it hears matters which may specifically be referred to it under the Constitution by the President of India. It also may take cognizance of matters on its own, without anyone drawing its attention to them. The law declared by the Supreme Court becomes binding on all courts within India.

basic_profile.name: Chintan Thakkar
basic_profile.headline: Group CEO IAN Group, Sr Managing Partner IAN Alpha Fund Backing Founders * Partnering with LPs & Angel Investors
basic_profile.summary: Great companies are built by exceptional founders. Great investment outcomes are built through patient capital, disciplined governance and trusted partnerships. After 12 years as Group CFO and Board Member of Info Edge—one of India’s leading listed technology companies, recognised for entrepreneurship, corporate governance and marquee investments—I now lead IAN Group as Group CEO and serve as Senior Managing Partner of IAN Alpha Fund.  I bring together operating leadership, public-market governance, capital markets expertise and venture investing to back founders building enduring companies, create long-term value for LPs, and enable angel investors to invest alongside exceptional entrepreneurs.  IAN combines one of India’s largest angel investor networks with a SEBI-registered venture capital fund, supporting entrepreneurs from inception through scale.  At Info Edge, I worked closely with founders and management teams through capital raises, M&A, governance challenges and business inflection points. During my tenure, the company grew nearly 20x in market capitalisation, from around ₹5,000 crore to over ₹1,00,000 crore by early 2025. I was closely involved in building category-leading businesses such as Naukri.com and 99acres.com and in developing Info Edge’s venture investment portfolio.  I played pivotal role in establishing the Info Edge Venture Fund and subsequently partnered with Temasek to scale it into an approximately US$450 million investment platform.  I had the privilege of being part of the journeys of companies such as Zomato and Policybazaar from early-stage investments to large listed companies.  I also led US$375 million of QIPs, strategic investments and M&A, and managed institutional investor relationships across multiple market cycles.  Earlier, I spent 15 years at CA Technologies helping establish India as a strategic hub for product engineering, the domestic market and partnerships with leading Indian system integrators, contributing to a significant large business footprint.  Today, my focus is on backing exceptional founders, building strong investor–founder partnerships and creating sustainable long-term value through disciplined venture investing and governance.Recognition: CFO of the Year 2023 – Financial Express (Large & Mid-Cap Category)

basic_info.name: Vayana
basic_info.description: Vayana is India's Most-Trusted Trade Credit Infrastructure, solving problems from Credit Intelligence to Liquidity for Supply Chains. Vayana offers a range of Trade Credit and Trade Enablement solutions across all tiers of the Supply Chain. Having financed close to USD 70 billion to date, Vayana is the preferred Supply Chain Finance partner for banks, financial institutions, and anchor corporates. Vayana connects corporates and their trade ecosystems by providing digital, convenient, and affordable access to trade credit for their payables and receivables. With its proprietary technology, Vayana has processed over 12 million financing transactions. The network spans 600 cities and 2000+ PIN codes in India, increasingly catering to the smallest of MSMEs in the long tail of supply chains.Vayana is India's Leading GSP (GST Suvidha Provider), facilitating GST, E-Way bill filing, and E-invoicing for enterprises, and its platform has processed over 11 billion GSP API calls, with zero downtime since inception.To help businesses assess credit & supplier risk within their distribution networks and supply chains, Rubix Data Sciences (a Vayana Group company) offers the award-winning Rubix ARMSTM Platform for continuous monitoring of credit, supplier, and counterparty risk of their customers, distributors, dealers, suppliers, and borrowers. Rubix solutions are trusted by 1500+ corporates, banks, credit insurance companies, and fintechs to assess and monitor the risk of over 600,000 MSMEs in India and overseas each year.Vayana TradeXchange, an IFSCA-licensed platform at GIFT City, is a leading provider of Cross-Border Trade Finance, extending the Group's reach beyond India to global supply chains.Together, these businesses reflect Vayana Group's expanding footprint across the Trade Credit value chain - from Risk Intelligence and Compliance to Domestic and Cross-Border Trade Financing, bringing Trade Credit within reach of every business, across the supply chain.

basic_profile.headline:

Author (Writing as Sanjay Uvacha) | FinTech, AI & Digital Transformation | Building Human-Centered Technology Ecosystems
basic_profile.current_title: EVP & Head - Global Platforms, Alliances & FI Business
basic_profile.summary:
I have worked across a wide range of business, finance, and technology environments, helping build and scale ventures across global capital markets, structured credit, large government digitisation initiatives, and early-stage financial institutions, including the seeding of an NBFC.

My experience spans financial services, fintech, software, hardware, and artificial intelligence—often at the intersection of complex systems, regulation, and long-term strategy. I have been involved in creating and scaling multiple businesses through distinctive transactions and platform-led approaches, with several ideas still evolving.

My career began with formal training in engineering, followed by nearly two decades in global, high-end finance with leading institutions. Over the past decade, my focus has shifted toward fintech, health tech, planet tech, and applied AI—areas where technology meaningfully reshapes markets, institutions, and decision-making.

At heart, I am a lifelong learner, interested in how technology, capital, and human behaviour interact over time. I enjoy engaging with people across disciplines, geographies, cultures, and generations, and value thoughtful, long-horizon conversations.

- Author: I write and publish under the pen name Sanjay Uvacha, exploring the structural and human implications of technology:

* FinTech Future: The Digital DNA of Finance :
An examination of how digital technology is transforming the traditionally conservative world of finance—and why this transformation will continue to accelerate globally.
https://www.amazon.in/dp/9353882486

* AI Decoded :
A human-centred perspective on artificial intelligence, focused on clarity, context, and understanding where AI fits into everyday work and life—beyond hype or fear.
https://amzn.in/d/41hnHPG

- Writing & Conversations :
I have been blogging intermittently for over a decade, reflecting on technology, systems, and societal change.

- Podcasting :
During the pandemic, I began podcasting on themes around human potential, technology, and the future.

🎙️ Superhuman Talks
https://open.spotify.com/episode/7vjsHU3sbye0qrIU6NUPeu

I remain open to thoughtful conversations, shared learning, and collaboration around technology, finance, and long-term value creation.

Third, students apply this toolkit to specialize in a field of their choice (Finance, Public Policy, or Data Analytics). Fourth, students contribute to increasing the existing body of knowledge through a dissertation which builds research and writing skills.

Rubix Data Sciences Pvt. Ltd. helps companies take prudent credit risks, build a robust supply chain and monitor compliance for their business partners in India and around the world. The Rubix platform and its suite of reports, products and services are based on its extensive database of structured and unstructured data aggregated from over 120+ sources, customized predictive analytics and proprietary technology. I was also involved in the establishment of Acuite Ratings & Research Ltd. (formerly SMERA Ratings Ltd), a joint venture with SIDBI, and served on its Board.  

I am also a Member of the Young Presidents Organization (YPO) and Entrepreneurs Organization. 

Specialties: Establishing and growing businesses within the Business Knowledge and Insight domain.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Vayana is India's Most-Trusted Trade Credit Infrastructure, solving problems from Credit Intelligence to Liquidity for Supply Chains. past.employer_linkedin_description: Seawise Capital is a UK based trade finance company for exporters in emerging markets. With payment cycles increasing globally, a growing number of SMEs face cashflow issues and require trade finance. However for exporting SMEs in emerging markets, obtaining trade finance continues to be a difficulty. 74% of their finance requests are rejected by banks, with at least 36% believed to be fundable. Banks also require the SME to pledge collateral, and only offer recourse based financing. It can take months to get a facility in place, and there are often hidden charges and costs.Seawise Capital simplifies the process of securing financing for SME Exporters, by providing an intuitive and efficient digital platform to support small businesses and assist them in competing in the international market. With low-cost, collateral-free financing facilities, we offer exporters real trade finance solutions in a matter of days. Using our proprietary Tech engine, we track and analyse over 1,000 data points for every exporter/ importer, leading to robust and quick underwriting. Our customer portal not only provides clients with real-time information regarding their export operations, but also offers a quick and transparent communications platform. Seawise Capital is on a mission to make Trade Finance accessible to exporters globally, and bring it into the digital age. Get in touch with us, if you are interested in learning more about how our solutions could help your business.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Vayana is India's Most-Trusted Trade Credit Infrastructure, solving problems from Credit Intelligence to Liquidity for Supply Chains. Vayana offers a range of Trade Credit and Trade Enablement solutions across all tiers of the Supply Chain. Having financed close to USD 70 billion to date, Vayana is the preferred Supply Chain Finance partner for banks, financial institutions, and anchor corporates. Vayana connects corporates and their trade ecosystems by providing digital, convenient, and affordable access to trade credit for their payables and receivables. With its proprietary technology, Vayana has processed over 12 million financing transactions. The network spans 600 cities and 2000+ PIN codes in India, increasingly catering to the smallest of MSMEs in the long tail of supply chains.Vayana is India's Leading GSP (GST Suvidha Provider), facilitating GST, E-Way bill filing, and E-invoicing for enterprises, and its platform has processed over 11 billion GSP API calls, with zero downtime since inception.To help businesses assess credit & supplier risk within their distribution networks and supply chains, Rubix Data Sciences (a Vayana Group company) offers the award-winning Rubix ARMSTM Platform for continuous monitoring of credit, supplier, and counterparty risk of their customers, distributors, dealers, suppliers, and borrowers. Rubix solutions are trusted by 1500+ corporates, banks, credit insurance companies, and fintechs to assess and monitor the risk of over 600,000 MSMEs in India and overseas each year.Vayana TradeXchange, an IFSCA-licensed platform at GIFT City, is a leading provider of Cross-Border Trade Finance, extending the Group's reach beyond India to global supply chains.Together, these businesses reflect Vayana Group's expanding footprint across the Trade Credit value chain - from Risk Intelligence and Compliance to Domestic and Cross-Border Trade Financing, bringing Trade Credit within reach of every business, across the supply chain.

With experience across global banks and high-growth fintechs, I bring a unique lens to building compliant, scalable infrastructure that deepens access to India’s evolving credit ecosystem.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Vayana is India's Most-Trusted Trade Credit Infrastructure, solving problems from Credit Intelligence to Liquidity for Supply Chains. Vayana offers a range of Trade Credit and Trade Enablement solutions across all tiers of the Supply Chain. Having financed close to USD 70 billion to date, Vayana is the preferred Supply Chain Finance partner for banks, financial institutions, and anchor corporates. Rubix solutions are trusted by 1500+ corporates, banks, credit insurance companies, and fintechs to assess and monitor the risk of over 600,000 MSMEs in India and overseas each year.Vayana TradeXchange, an IFSCA-licensed platform at GIFT City, is a leading provider of Cross-Border Trade Finance, extending the Group's reach beyond India to global supply chains.Together, these businesses reflect Vayana Group's expanding footprint across the Trade Credit value chain - from Risk Intelligence and Compliance to Domestic and Cross-Border Trade Financing, bringing Trade Credit within reach of every business, across the supply chain.

past.employer_linkedin_description: K. P. WOVEN PRIVATE LIMITED is a mining & metals company based out of MOTI NIWAS GURU NANAK COLONY, GUNA, Madhya Pradesh, India.

Ours is a flagship company of the Champalal group based in Gandhidham, Gujarat, India. The company made a humble beginning in year 1998, formerly known as Oswal Agloimpex Private Limited, involved in importing plastic scrap and reprocessing it to manufacture agglomerates which were sold to various plastic manufacturers.In year 2005, the company ventured into the manufacturing of woven sacks and woven fabrics at Nani Chirai, Gujarat for servicing domestic salt, cement and fertilizer industry.Under the dynamic leadership of Mr. Prakash Parekh (Managing Director), the company gradually expanded its product portfolio and started manufacturing FIBC (Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers), flexible packaging, tarpaulin, multifilament yarn and masterbatch. As a result, became the world’s only company to start up with 21,000 metric ton (mt) annual capacity.In year 2007, the name of the company was changed to Plastene India Limited to meditate wider activities of our company. The company was declared as India’s best performing mid-size company during 2006-07 by Business World Magazine.Looking Ahead: It's where the crystal ball normally comes out and lofty predictions are generally made. At Plastene, however, the future is not what we are going to do, but the company is already doing things which would bear fruit on at a later date.In other words “The future has already began”
past.employee_description:
Plastene India Limited is a leading plastics packaging manufacturer in India with a diverse product portfolio comprising of FIBCs, small bags and multiplayer films.
The Company was originally incorporated on October 16, 1998 as Oswal Agloimpex Private Limited at Ahmedabad, Gujarat and was converted into public limited company in 2006. Thereafter, the name of the company was changed to Plastene India Limited.
During the year 2005, the Company started the flexible packaging unit at Nani Chirai, Kutch, in the state of Gujarat, for manufacturing woven sacks for cement and fertilizer companies and gradually expanded to other products like FIBC, BOPP laminates bags, and Technical Textiles.
By 2013, the Company’s turnover had crossed INR 6 billion equivalent to USD 100 million and has expanded to 10 manufacturing locations, all located in Gujarat, India. All the locations are strategically located close to Mundra Port, the largest Private Port in India.
Plastene currently exports to around 30 countries and derives close to 65% sales from international customers. Plastene provides a strong foothold to access and participate in India’s growth story while providing a cost efficient platform to serve global markets.
Currently Plastene is second largest FIBC bags Manufacturer in Indi

current.employer_linkedin_description: Vayana is India's Most-Trusted Trade Credit Infrastructure, solving problems from Credit Intelligence to Liquidity for Supply Chains. Vayana offers a range of Trade Credit and Trade Enablement solutions across all tiers of the Supply Chain. Having financed close to USD 70 billion to date, Vayana is the preferred Supply Chain Finance partner for banks, financial institutions, and anchor corporates. Vayana connects corporates and their trade ecosystems by providing digital, convenient, and affordable access to trade credit for their payables and receivables. With its proprietary technology, Vayana has processed over 12 million financing transactions. The network spans 600 cities and 2000+ PIN codes in India, increasingly catering to the smallest of MSMEs in the long tail of supply chains.Vayana is India's Leading GSP (GST Suvidha Provider), facilitating GST, E-Way bill filing, and E-invoicing for enterprises, and its platform has processed over 11 billion GSP API calls, with zero downtime since inception.To help businesses assess credit & supplier risk within their distribution networks and supply chains, Rubix Data Sciences (a Vayana Group company) offers the award-winning Rubix ARMSTM Platform for continuous monitoring of credit, supplier, and counterparty risk of their customers, distributors, dealers, suppliers, and borrowers. Rubix solutions are trusted by 1500+ corporates, banks, credit insurance companies, and fintechs to assess and monitor the risk of over 600,000 MSMEs in India and overseas each year.Vayana TradeXchange, an IFSCA-licensed platform at GIFT City, is a leading provider of Cross-Border Trade Finance, extending the Group's reach beyond India to global supply chains.Together, these businesses reflect Vayana Group's expanding footprint across the Trade Credit value chain - from Risk Intelligence and Compliance to Domestic and Cross-Border Trade Financing, bringing Trade Credit within reach of every business, across the supply chain.

current.employee_description:
In my current stint at Vayana Network, I am currently leading the end-to-end architecture and development of a single-tenant Loan Management System (LMS) powering Supply Chain Financing operations for major Indian banks.

Built and delivered core platform capabilities, including:
    - Integrations with third-party fintech partners for trade-document ingestion
    - Loan disbursement, interest booking and repayment workflows tightly integrated with Core Banking Systems (CBS)
    - Daily interest accrual, capitalization, amortization and refund engines with configurable EOD/BOD cycles
    - Automated repayment apportioning framework
    - SMA/NPA classification, monitoring, and regulatory tracking
    - Custom MIS modules and bank-specific reporting pipelines

Re-architecting the legacy monolithic LMS into a scalable, resilient microservice-based platform. Designing and implementing the migration for major Banks in India from their legacy LMS to the Vayana LMS Platform

Designed and implemented platform support for multiple SCF programs —
Dealer Financing, Vendor Financing, Payables Financing, and Factoring
— with configurable rule-based workflows.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Rainmatter Climate Foundation is a Zerodha-sponsored initiative focused on fostering and assisting ideas that help preserve and regenerate ecosystems. We believe that this needs both direct interventions as well as the enablement of larger platforms that involve a mainstream understanding of the need and benefits of these efforts while also scaling participation in them beyond the philanthropic efforts of a few. Indeed we do not see this as charity; it is an investment into our own future and wellbeing.Amongst our core beliefs is that moving to a green economy and creating green jobs is an essential part of the changes needed for a better ecology. We also think that this needs to happen in a distributed fashion across geographies, with value and job creation everywhere and not being limited to a few urban centres. Reversing both migration and concentration of value, wealth and resources are a major need towards this and will also need a strengthening of public goods and services across India.Rainmatter Climate Foundation is uniquely positioned to influence these efforts in terms of the market and technology skills and partnerships we bring to the table. Additionally, we are committing a $100mn fund towards this over the coming few years. This will be disbursed as grants and funding for projects in the above directions that become replicable models. It will also be used for the creation of open, collaborative platforms that cross-pollinate and scale many good ideas and successful experiments and help create a green economy everywhere. This includes our commitments to funding open-source efforts that help create projects and platforms for climate change and related efforts. Rainmatter Foundation is also incubating and investing in entrepreneurship that helps with these directions and helps move towards a greener, more equitable, and lower footprint economy.
current.employee_description: We setup the Rainmatter Foundation to support organisations and causes focusing on climate change, ecology, and livelihoods tied to them. We have committed much of the resources at Zerodha to the foundation.

current.employer_linkedin_description: FOSS United Foundation is a registered non-profit founded in 2020, dedicated to the cause of building Free and Open Source (FOSS) projects and communities in India and elsewhere. It originally started out as the ERP Next foundation in 2016 with the same broad goals. Its new avatar is a joint collaboration between the teams at Frappe, the publisher of ERPNext, one of the largest FOSS projects out of India, and Zerodha, India's largest stockbroker and a fintech company.The foundation, currently in its infancy, aims to provide grassroots support to FOSS projects and events and invite industry patronage to support FOSS, in India.India is now a hub of startups, innovative consumer software, developer communities, and largescale technological infrastructure. However, somewhere along the lines, the spirit of FOSS and hacking seems to have been overshadowed. This is illustrated by the disproportionately low number of quality FOSS projects coming out of India given a thriving industry compared to the explosion of projects that have happened globally over the last decade.In the Indian context, our goals are:To promote the spirit of hacking, tinkering, and writing code, not only for profit but for fun.To build quality FOSS for the public good.To build quality free software that specifically empowers people with tools to run their livelihoods and power the economy.

current.employer_linkedin_description: NJ Mutual Fund is part of the 27 year old NJ Group. NJ Group is one of the leading players in the Indian financial services industry known for its strong distribution capabilities. Mr. Neeraj Choksi  & Mr. Jignesh Desai are two first generation entrepreneurs who began the journey of 'NJ' in 1994. The group has 95+ offices across the country. NJ India Invest contributes more than Rs. 1,30,000+ crore to the current assets under management (AUM) of the Indian Mutual Fund Industry through more than 27,000+ active partners. At NJ Mutual Fund, we are led by data driven expertise. The company will focus on a Rule-Based Investment management style. Our Investment Philosophy will endeavour to deliver superior returns while keeping risks under control.The Investment Team will achieve the above objective with a three pronged approach, wherein:  - Put to use time tested factor based rules to identify stocks which show potential to deliver superior returns.  - Leverage financial data and balance sheet information, in addition to business responsibility reports & ESG scorecards, to eliminate companies which have the potential to significantly destroy wealth.  - Finally, based on the correlation between identified stocks, their volatility and expected returns, we will use sophisticated tools to create optimal portfolio weights for each stock in the portfolio.Through this process, we will be able to reduce human biases to the minimum and develop Rule-Based methodologies which aims to deliver active returns over and above the benchmark. Eventually, a Rule-Based investing methodology is expected to simplify investing for investors and Partners. This process delivers "True to Label" portfolios with minimal human intervention on a day to day basis.For more information, please visit www.njmutualfund.com

Build and maintain relationships with clients, understanding their investment objectives, risk tolerance, and financial circumstances.

Maintain accurate records of client transactions, communications, and regulatory filings.
Participate in compliance training programs and stay abreast of regulatory developments to ensure adherence to applicable laws and regulations.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Rainmatter Climate Foundation is a Zerodha-sponsored initiative focused on fostering and assisting ideas that help preserve and regenerate ecosystems. We believe that this needs both direct interventions as well as the enablement of larger platforms that involve a mainstream understanding of the need and benefits of these efforts while also scaling participation in them beyond the philanthropic efforts of a few. Indeed we do not see this as charity; it is an investment into our own future and wellbeing.Amongst our core beliefs is that moving to a green economy and creating green jobs is an essential part of the changes needed for a better ecology. We also think that this needs to happen in a distributed fashion across geographies, with value and job creation everywhere and not being limited to a few urban centres. Reversing both migration and concentration of value, wealth and resources are a major need towards this and will also need a strengthening of public goods and services across India.Rainmatter Climate Foundation is uniquely positioned to influence these efforts in terms of the market and technology skills and partnerships we bring to the table. Additionally, we are committing a $100mn fund towards this over the coming few years. This will be disbursed as grants and funding for projects in the above directions that become replicable models. It will also be used for the creation of open, collaborative platforms that cross-pollinate and scale many good ideas and successful experiments and help create a green economy everywhere. This includes our commitments to funding open-source efforts that help create projects and platforms for climate change and related efforts. Rainmatter Foundation is also incubating and investing in entrepreneurship that helps with these directions and helps move towards a greener, more equitable, and lower footprint economy.
current.employee_description: We setup the Rainmatter Foundation to support organisations and causes focusing on climate change, ecology, and livelihoods tied to them. We have committed much of the resources at Zerodha to the foundation.

current.employer_linkedin_description: FOSS United Foundation is a registered non-profit founded in 2020, dedicated to the cause of building Free and Open Source (FOSS) projects and communities in India and elsewhere. It originally started out as the ERP Next foundation in 2016 with the same broad goals. Its new avatar is a joint collaboration between the teams at Frappe, the publisher of ERPNext, one of the largest FOSS projects out of India, and Zerodha, India's largest stockbroker and a fintech company.The foundation, currently in its infancy, aims to provide grassroots support to FOSS projects and events and invite industry patronage to support FOSS, in India.India is now a hub of startups, innovative consumer software, developer communities, and largescale technological infrastructure. However, somewhere along the lines, the spirit of FOSS and hacking seems to have been overshadowed. This is illustrated by the disproportionately low number of quality FOSS projects coming out of India given a thriving industry compared to the explosion of projects that have happened globally over the last decade.In the Indian context, our goals are:To promote the spirit of hacking, tinkering, and writing code, not only for profit but for fun.To build quality FOSS for the public good.To build quality free software that specifically empowers people with tools to run their livelihoods and power the economy.
current.employee_description: We setup the FOSS United Foundation to support Free and Open Source (FOSS) projects and communities in India. FOSS United runs community programs and events and provides funding to FOSS projects.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) was founded in 1909 as a result of the joint efforts of Jamsetji Nusserwanji Tata, the Government of India, and the Maharaja of Mysore. In 1886, Jamsetji Tata conceived of a university of science that would work for the benefit of India, and in 1898 created an endowment for establishing such an institution. The Government of India then took up the effort, and, in consultation with scientists in England and in India, decided to locate the Institute in Bengaluru, where the Maharaja of Mysore, Shri Krishnaraja Wodeyar IV, donated 372 acres of land. The Institute was formally vested in 1909, the foundation stone was laid in 1911, and the first batch of students started their studies in the same year.Over the last century, IISc has become the premier institute for advanced scientific and technological research and education in India. Beginning with 2 departments and 21 students in 1911, today IISc has 39 departments, units, or centres, 3500 students, and about 500 academic and scientific staff, supported by 600 administrative personnel. About 2200 students are in various PhD programs, almost 900 are enrolled for various Masters degrees, whereas about 400 are registered in the newly established, research oriented, four-year Bachelor of Science (Research) programme.In recent years, the Institute has vigorously promoted interdisciplinary research. New centres such as the CiSTUP, the Robert Bosch Centre for Cyber Physical Systems and a new Centre for Brain Research (funded by a large private endowment) are expected to conduct translational research in their respective areas, in order to better connect with industry and society. With the recent construction of modern buildings, acquisition of new research facilities, and induction of a large number of new faculty members, the Institute can look forward to an era of high productivity, increasing impact, and rising prominence in the world.
past.employee_description: Under guidance of Prof. V. Nanjundiah and Prof. S. Mahadevan in Molecular Reproduction, Development and Genetics department of IISc, Bangalore, developed a quantitative model for the regulation of the bgl operon in E. coli. The prestigious summer research fellowship was awarded by the Indian Academy of Sciences.

Working under Dr. Mukund Thattai at National Center for Biological Sciences, Bangalore, developed a web based tool for predicting subclasses of proteins (belonging to a specific protein family) based on its amino acid sequence only.

Under guidance of Dr. Ram Ramaswamy, modeled the phenomenon involving synchronization of flashes in a group of fireflies (of a select species). Specifically, implemented Mirollo and Strogatz model, verified it and later expanded it to include spatial considerations.

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

basic_profile.name: Alix de Sagazan
basic_profile.headline: CRO & Co-founder at Wingify
basic_profile.summary: I co-founded AB Tasty, a Digital Experience Optimization platform, with Rémi Aubert in 2009.Over the next 16 years, we built the company from the ground up, reaching €65M in ARR, 300 employees, and more than 1,000 customers worldwide. Along the way, we built a truly international organization, opening offices in Paris, Cologne, Berlin, London, Madrid, Singapore, Sydney, and New York.As part of that journey, I moved to New York and spent seven years there building and scaling our US business, establishing AB Tasty in what became one of our most strategic markets.At AB Tasty, our mission has always been to empower digital teams to create amazing digital experiences. From the beginning, we believed that technology alone was not enough: the best technology needs to be combined with human expertise to help teams understand their customers, make better decisions, and continuously improve their digital experiences.In 2026, AB Tasty was acquired by Everstone Capital, a Singapore-headquartered private equity firm, and combined with our long-standing partner VWO to create Wingify.Today, Wingify is a global Agentic Experience Optimization Platform helping brands understand their customers and turn those insights into action. The platform brings together experimentation, personalization, behavioral insights, feature management, commerce optimization, and AI into one integrated suite — enabling digital teams to continuously understand, decide, act, and measure across every digital touchpoint.Together, we are now 700+ people serving more than 4,000 customers globally, with one ambition: Make every digital experience relevant.

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

basic_profile.summary:
I’m a product builder obsessed with one thing: shrinking the distance between “users said this” and “we shipped that.” Today, I’m at Wingify (VWO), helping shape how feedback and insights work across web + mobile.

Before this, I co-founded Blitzllama (YC W22) - an AI-powered feedback engine for real-time, in-product insights and unified customer feedback. Earlier, I led product and design at Spoyl, scaling it to 500K monthly active users and running experiments that took off across Tier-2 and Tier-3 India.

Outside work, I’m usually geeking out over gadgets, science/history rabbit holes, or tinkering with AI tools just to see what they can do.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Blitzllama makes it easy for product teams to collect and analyze product feedback.With targeted in-product surveys, you can effortlessly ask questions to users at any stage of their product journey, obtaining results in hours instead of weeks. In-the-moment surveys lead to highly contextual feedback, producing response rates of 20-70% – up to 10 times higher than email surveys.Blitzllama's GPT3-powered feedback analytics instantly categorize and translates textual feedback into topics, sentiments, and recommendations. past.employee_description:
Blitzllama (YC W22) started with a problem I kept running into as a product builder: teams could track every click, but struggled to understand 'why' users dropped off, hesitated, or churned. 
I co-founded Blitzllama and ran GTM, product, and design - building the platform, the narrative, and the motion in parallel. We helped teams capture in-product feedback in the moment, then used AI to turn it into structured insights they could ship against.

In 2025, Wingify (VWO) acquired Blitzllama. I solely led the acquisition from outreach through close, and joined VWO post-acquisition to lead integration and scale Blitzllama’s capabilities inside a much larger platform.

basic_profile.name: Rémi Aubert
basic_profile.headline: CCO / CSO & co-Founder at Wingify
basic_profile.summary:
I am an entrepreneur in the user experience space. I co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. What started as a small team of two has grown into a thriving company with 300 employees, raising $60 million in funding and achieving profitability.

My journey at AB Tasty has allowed me to experience all the phases of building a tech company—from hyper-growth to large-scale recruitment, as well as navigating more challenging restructuring periods. We’ve completed 4 strategic acquisitions and developed structured approaches to product, pricing, go-to-market, sales, finance, and HR. I also manage multidisciplinary teams, blending internal growth with the recruitment of external experienced talent.

As a first-time entrepreneur, I’ve built expertise in both the bottom line and top line, which has helped me steer AB Tasty to a leadership position in its market. My goal is to continue innovating and transforming the user experience through the solutions we develop.

In addition to my role at AB Tasty, I serve on the boards of several companies, including The Galion Project, FairJungle, Synbird, and JoinStories, where I provide strategic and growth expertise.

current.employee_description:
Co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. Over 16 years, built it from a Paris web-analytics consultancy into the leading experience optimization platforms worldwide, then combined it with VWO in 2026.
 
2010–2013 · From consulting to SaaS
Started as Liwio, a web analytics consultancy. Turned it into a software company and launched a visual A/B testing tool that marketers could use without writing code.
 
2014–2017 · International expansion
First round of €1.1M from Kima Ventures and XAnge (2014), then €5M with Omnes Capital (2016) and a €17M Series B with Partech and Korelya Capital (2017). Opened offices in London, Madrid, Cologne and Sydney, with clients in ~40 countries. Acquired Nirror (session replay, 2016). Opened New York and San Francisco.
 
2018–2021 · Hyper-scale
Opened Singapore and obtained a Chinese ICP licence to serve clients in China (2018). Launched Flagship, for feature flagging and server-side experimentation (2019). Raised a €40M Series C led by Crédit Mutuel Innovation (2020), bringing total funding to €63M+. US revenue grew 480% in two years. Joined the French Tech Next40 (2021).
 
2022–2025 · Building the platform through M&A
Four acquisitions to build an all-in-one optimization suite:
Epoq (Germany, 2022): AI recommendations and search
Dotaki (France, 2023): emotion-based personalization
Potions (France, 2024): cookieless merchandising
Wandz.ai (Israel, 2025): real-time predictive personalization for anonymous visitors
Grew from ~60 people (2016) to 300+ across 11–13 offices in Europe, North America and APAC, serving 1,000+ brands.
 
2026 · Combination with VWO to create Wingify
Combined AB Tasty with VWO, backed by Everstone Capital. The new group has $100M+ ARR, 4,000+ customers and ~800 people.
 
Clients over the years included L'Oréal, LVMH, Kering, Sephora, YSL Beauty, Kiehl's, Urban Decay, Ulta Beauty, McDonald's, Disneyland Paris, Samsonite, USA Today, Ganni, Ashley Furniture....

past.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. current.employer_linkedin_description: Kahoona was founded in 2022 by Gal Rapoport and Alon Ashkenasi - AI, privacy, cybersecurity, and behavioral analytics experts who previously led personalization at Amazon.Every AI or intelligent system, from personalization engines, data platforms, fraud & risk solutions, to conversational AI agents, suffer from the AI cold-start problem. They cannot generate context about the actor, user or agent, before identity exists and depend on it to function. The web was never built with a context layer, and every system built on top of it is unable to understand and act on >96% of the actors on the web.Kahoona is the context generation layer of the web, an AI infrastructure that gives every digital property the ability to understand every visitor or agent before identity exists. It generates decision-ready context, with a privacy-by-design approach (no PII), with a site-native script that reads anonymous actors and their Digital Body Language (Kahoona’s unique HCI data modality) and with site-specific AI models Kahoona serves continuously learnt context both for the enterprise teams and for the end-users. Kahoona is focusing on ‘how’ actors behave rather than ‘what’ they do. Kahoona does not enrich, match, or aggregate existing data. It generates intelligence that did not exist before.The adaptive intelligence is live, persistent and feeds every downstream system that needs to understand, decide and act: It is the input layer that digital stacks were always missing.Winner of the LVMH Award for Best Business Impact, and Kering Innovation Award, Kahoona’s AI Hyper-Personalization is scaling across digital and omnichannel teams within ecommerce brands, CPG  & retail, travel & hospitality, financial services & insurance, telecom, and more. Headquartered in New York.

basic_profile.name: Jan Marks
basic_profile.headline: Founder & Publisher at Conversion.News | Bringing the CRO community together | Experimentation, Personalization & Digital Growth
basic_profile.summary: Conversion Optimization works best when people share what they learn. That is something smart people in the CRO space taught me, and it is why we are building Conversion.News.Conversion.News will be the media house for the Conversion Optimization community and industry. We are bringing people together in three places: our digital channel, our podcast and regional Conversion Days.Across all three, we are focusing on what makes people and companies more successful in CRO: best practices and cases, tools and innovations, agencies and experts, insights and events.For partners and contributors, Conversion.News will offer visibility and access to a highly relevant audience. For companies building or scaling their CRO programs, we will help find the right technology and the right expertise.I decided to start this because I have seen CRO from three sides: As a business, when the travel giant TUI wondered what to do with the internet, and as Managing Director of lastminute.com after the dotcom crash, when we learned that buying traffic was no longer enough. As an agency, where I helped clients of Multiplica launch and scale successful CRO programs. And as a technology provider at VWO, where I got to know the SaaS business from the inside.All three taught me the same lesson: digital growth requires three Ps, the right Platforms, People and Processes. And that is what Conversion.News is all about.Got a story, a case or a question about CRO? Let’s talk!

Its graduates may be found throughout the world in all areas of engineering, science and commerce. BITS symbolizes the maturing of Indian technical ability and "can-do" entrepreneurial spirit, especially as derived from the private sector. BITS is located in the Vidya Vihar campus adjacent to the town of Pilani in Rajasthan.Admission is merit-based, as assessed by the online BITSAT examination. AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

Engineering leader with 17+ years of experience delivering scalable systems, leading cross-functional teams, and driving innovation across SaaS, web experimentation, digital identity, and AI.

The Sonatype journey started 15 years ago, just as the concept of “open source” software development was gaining steam. From our humble beginning as core contributors to Apache Maven, to supporting the world’s largest repository of open source components (Central), to distributing the world's most popular repository manager (Sonatype Nexus Repository), we’ve played a meaningful role in helping the world embrace the power of open innovation.Over time, we witnessed the staggering volume and variety of open source libraries that began flowing into every development environment in the world. We understood that when open source components are properly managed, they provide a tremendous energy for accelerating innovation.  Conversely, when unmanaged, open source "gone wild" can lead directly to security vulnerabilities, licensing risks, enormous rework, and waste.Our vision today is simple.We are laser focused on helping organizations continuously harness all of the good that open source has to offer, without any of the risk. In order to do this, we have invested in knowing more about the quality of open source than anyone else in the world. This investment takes the form of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and human expertise, which in aggregate produces highly curated intelligence that is infused into every Sonatype product. Organizations equipped with Sonatype products make better decisions, innovate faster at scale, and rest comfortably knowing that their applications always consist of the highest quality open source components.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Depuis 1933, la compagnie Air France porte haut les couleurs de la France à travers le monde entier. Air France, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines et Transavia forment le Groupe Air France-KLM. Dans le cadre du programme Horizon 2030, la compagnie s’est engagée à réduire de 50% ses émissions de CO2 par passager-kilomètre d’ici à 2030 à travers des investissements importants en faveur du renouvellement de sa flotte par des avions de nouvelle génération, l’utilisation de solutions innovantes pour réduire sa consommation de carburant ou encore l’utilisation progressive de carburants alternatifs durables.Plus d'informations sur : corporate.airfrance.com

past.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

🚀 Startup Technologist | Product Builder | Engineering Leader (16+ Years Experience)

With 16 years of end-to-end experience in building scalable products and high-performing teams across bootstrapped startups and growth-stage companies, I thrive at the intersection of technology, product, and business.

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

current.employee_description:
Co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. Over 16 years, built it from a Paris web-analytics consultancy into the leading experience optimization platforms worldwide, then combined it with VWO in 2026.
 
2010–2013 · From consulting to SaaS
Started as Liwio, a web analytics consultancy. Turned it into a software company and launched a visual A/B testing tool that marketers could use without writing code.
 
2014–2017 · International expansion
First round of €1.1M from Kima Ventures and XAnge (2014), then €5M with Omnes Capital (2016) and a €17M Series B with Partech and Korelya Capital (2017). Opened offices in London, Madrid, Cologne and Sydney, with clients in ~40 countries. Acquired Nirror (session replay, 2016). Opened New York and San Francisco.
 
2018–2021 · Hyper-scale
Opened Singapore and obtained a Chinese ICP licence to serve clients in China (2018). Launched Flagship, for feature flagging and server-side experimentation (2019). Raised a €40M Series C led by Crédit Mutuel Innovation (2020), bringing total funding to €63M+. US revenue grew 480% in two years. Joined the French Tech Next40 (2021).
 
2022–2025 · Building the platform through M&A
Four acquisitions to build an all-in-one optimization suite:
Epoq (Germany, 2022): AI recommendations and search
Dotaki (France, 2023): emotion-based personalization
Potions (France, 2024): cookieless merchandising
Wandz.ai (Israel, 2025): real-time predictive personalization for anonymous visitors
Grew from ~60 people (2016) to 300+ across 11–13 offices in Europe, North America and APAC, serving 1,000+ brands.
 
2026 · Combination with VWO to create Wingify
Combined AB Tasty with VWO, backed by Everstone Capital. The new group has $100M+ ARR, 4,000+ customers and ~800 people.
 
Clients over the years included L'Oréal, LVMH, Kering, Sephora, YSL Beauty, Kiehl's, Urban Decay, Ulta Beauty, McDonald's, Disneyland Paris, Samsonite, USA Today, Ganni, Ashley Furniture....
