current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com
current.employee_description:
Co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. Over 16 years, built it from a Paris web-analytics consultancy into the leading experience optimization platforms worldwide, then combined it with VWO in 2026.
 
2010–2013 · From consulting to SaaS
Started as Liwio, a web analytics consultancy. Turned it into a software company and launched a visual A/B testing tool that marketers could use without writing code.
 
2014–2017 · International expansion
First round of €1.1M from Kima Ventures and XAnge (2014), then €5M with Omnes Capital (2016) and a €17M Series B with Partech and Korelya Capital (2017). Opened offices in London, Madrid, Cologne and Sydney, with clients in ~40 countries. Acquired Nirror (session replay, 2016). Opened New York and San Francisco.
 
2018–2021 · Hyper-scale
Opened Singapore and obtained a Chinese ICP licence to serve clients in China (2018). Launched Flagship, for feature flagging and server-side experimentation (2019). Raised a €40M Series C led by Crédit Mutuel Innovation (2020), bringing total funding to €63M+. US revenue grew 480% in two years. Joined the French Tech Next40 (2021).
 
2022–2025 · Building the platform through M&A
Four acquisitions to build an all-in-one optimization suite:
Epoq (Germany, 2022): AI recommendations and search
Dotaki (France, 2023): emotion-based personalization
Potions (France, 2024): cookieless merchandising
Wandz.ai (Israel, 2025): real-time predictive personalization for anonymous visitors
Grew from ~60 people (2016) to 300+ across 11–13 offices in Europe, North America and APAC, serving 1,000+ brands.
 
2026 · Combination with VWO to create Wingify
Combined AB Tasty with VWO, backed by Everstone Capital. The new group has $100M+ ARR, 4,000+ customers and ~800 people.
 
Clients over the years included L'Oréal, LVMH, Kering, Sephora, YSL Beauty, Kiehl's, Urban Decay, Ulta Beauty, McDonald's, Disneyland Paris, Samsonite, USA Today, Ganni, Ashley Furniture....

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Birla Institute of Technology & Science (BITS), Pilani is a prestigious Indian university for higher education in science, technology and humanities. BITS Pilani has consistently ranked amongst the top universities in India. The acceptance rate of BITS Pilani is 1.47% making it the most selective university in India.The primary motive of BITS is to "train young men and women able and eager to create and put into action such ideas, methods, techniques and information". The Institute is a dream come true of its founder late Mr G.D.Birla - an eminent industrialist, a participant in Indian freedom struggle and a close associate of the Father of Indian Nation late Mr. Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (Mahatma Gandhi). What started in early 1900s as a small school, blossomed into a set of colleges for higher education, ranging from the Humanities to Engineering until 1964 when all these colleges amalgamated to culminate into a unique Indian University of International standing. This university was christened as the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, known to many as BITS, Pilani.Over the years, BITS has provided the highest quality technical education to students from all over India admitted on the basis of merit. Its graduates may be found throughout the world in all areas of engineering, science and commerce. BITS symbolizes the maturing of Indian technical ability and "can-do" entrepreneurial spirit, especially as derived from the private sector. BITS is located in the Vidya Vihar campus adjacent to the town of Pilani in Rajasthan.Admission is merit-based, as assessed by the online BITSAT examination. The fully residential institute is privately supported.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Bren Corporation or Bren Corporation Private Limited is an Indian real estate development company headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka founded by Boopesh Reddy in 2012. Bren Corporation is involved in developing and constructing residential, commercial, retail, and office spaces as well as infrastructure that includes roads, flyovers, bridges, and airport tarmacs. Over the years, Bren has emerged as one of the leading progressive builders of Bengaluru.The name Bren is an acronym for “Building Relationship Enterprises.” The company was founded on June 2, 2012. Prior to BREN, Boopesh Reddy has completed 9 Residential and 9 Commercial projects. Over the years, Bren has ventured into diverse endeavors such as education, business, interiors, and luxury furniture design. For the last ten years, Bren has been known to have completed over 20 projects, delivering over 15 Million Sq.Ft. of Diversified Assets across Residential, Commercial & Retail segments in prime locations of Bengaluru with over 10,000+ Happy Customers & esteemed client profiles.Bren’s unique philosophy through which it builds and designs spaces is known as Brennovation. Under Brennovation, Bren aims to design and develop residential and commercial spaces using cutting-edge technology and modern building techniques. Other distinguishing features that Bren incorporates are energy-efficient lifts, solar-powered lights, community safety zones, centralized heat pumps, smart water meter systems, built-in German kitchens, and much moreAs an organization, Bren believes in developing spaces to improve life on Earth. Bren's team of architects and engineers is known to have built a modern primate socializing habitat on the hospital campus in Bangalore to help orphaned, and separated macaques get back into groups. Mr. Boopesh Reddy believes that “The world doesn't belong to us, we, belong to the world".

current.employer_linkedin_description: Most students graduate with a degree.Some graduate with direction.Teedians is a community for undergraduate students who want to build themselves beyond the classroom.We believe college should be more than lectures, exams and placements. Papers are being downloaded at an annual rate of more than 12 million, with more than 150 million downloads to date.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The Space & Satellite Professionals International was founded in the USA in 1983, with Sir Arthur C. Clarke, creator of the satellite concept, as its honorary chairman.Our founding purpose was to serve as a professional network in a young industry that was on the verge of substantial growth. SSPI offered a way for satellite professionals to keep in touch with each other and with technology change in an industry that rapidly spread across the globe.Today, with over 3,000 members in more than 40 nations, our core mission has expanded. SSPI aims to promote space and satellite as the invisible but indispensable infrastructure of the modern world and to make the industry one of the world’s best at attracting and nurturing the talent that powers innovation.WHAT WE DOIn our founding year, satellites and space were the hottest technologies in the world. Today, they have to share the stage with information technology, Internet, biotech, nanotech and other industries pushing out the boundaries of what is possible. Our Better Satellite World campaign shows the world why our industry, though often invisible, is indispensable to modern life, through powerful stories and videos that depict space and satellite technologies contributing to the economy, society and sustainability of planet Earth.Fulfilling our industry’s potential means making it one of the most attractive, exciting and rewarding places that talented people can work. basic_profile.name: Shivansh Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Winter Intern’25 @IIT Indore | Summer Fellow’25 @IIT Jodhpur School of AIDE | BS @IIT Madras | Ex-Summer’24 Intern @DRMO | B.Tech in AI & DS @GSV | Co-author of 2 books | SEBI Certified Investor
basic_profile.summary:
​I am an AI Engineer, Data Scientist and entrepreneur dedicated to translating foundational deep learning research into scalable, real-world infrastructure. Currently pursuing a dual-degree—a B.Tech in AI & Data Science at Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya and a BS in Data Science from IIT Madras—my work exists at the intersection of generative modeling, autonomous systems, and sustainable tech.

​Raised with the values of resilience and hard work, my approach to leadership and problem-solving is deeply inspired by the philosophical teachings of the Shreemad Bhagavad Gita and Chanakya. This grounding shapes my core engineering belief: AI must not only be computationally efficient, but ethically aligned and deployed for true societal impact.

​► Research & Technical Highlights:
​Generative AI & Architecture: At IIT Indore, I tackled semantic distortion in Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation. I architected Frequency-Aware GANs, integrating Haar Wavelet Transforms with Vision Transformers (ViT) and CLIP encoders to enforce strict semantic consistency.

​Edge AI & Robotics: At SAIDE, IIT Jodhpur, I engineered a highly optimized MobileNet V2 perception engine for an autonomous AgriBot. Integrated with ROS2 path planning, the system achieved ~94.6% real-time accuracy in crop disease detection on edge hardware.

​Infrastructure & Simulation: I build systems that safeguard human lives. I engineered a multi-agent traffic simulation computing real-time Time-to-Collision (TTC) metrics, and my AI-powered traffic orchestration system utilizing Particle Swarm Optimization secured 1st Place at the Hack4Industry Hackathon.

​Speech AI: I am currently developing driver stress detection pipelines using acoustic feature extraction (MFCCs, pitch) to identify cognitive load via vocal biomarkers.

​► Entrepreneurial Leadership:
As the Founder & CEO of eeko, alongside an incredible founding team, we are building an AI-enabled supply chain for sustainable, edible millet tableware. Our mission to combine green logistics with IoT monitoring led us to become the 1st Runner-Up at the International Hult Prize Campus Grand Finale.

​Backed by an All India Rank of 94 in JEE Mains, an international Math Olympiad Silver Medal, and formal training in "AI in Society: Ethics and Justice" from the University of Edinburgh, I strive to be a multidimensional builder.

​Let's connect to discuss AI research, multi-modal data fusion, or tech for social good!

Members from the state's leading various political parties hold elected offices in the corporation.At present, the municipal area is divided into 19 zones and 85 wards of various sizes and population. As per the provision of Madhya Pradesh Municipal Corporation Act, 1956, IMC has a chairman (Mayor), councillors elected by direct election from 69 wards, 2 members of Parliament, 5 members of State Legislative Assembly representing constituencies within municipal areas. In accordance with the 74th constitutional amendment, 25 seats out of 69 are reserved for women.IMC has 13 departments:--Accounts Department-Education Department-Electrical and Mechanical Department-Fire Department-Food and Civil Supplies Department-Health Department-Housing & Environmental Department-Information Technology Department-Law and General Administration Department-Planning & Rehabilitation Department-Public Work Department-Revenue Department-Water Work and Drainage Department

basic_profile.headline: Aeronautics & Space Tech Undergrad @ IITM ’30 | NASA Citizen Scientist | Building & documenting, out loud ✨
basic_profile.summary: Hey! Since you clicked through — let me actually tell you who I am, not just what's on my resume. 👋 I'm 19, studying 𝐀𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐬 & 𝐒𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲 at 𝐈𝐈𝐓 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐬 — first-ever cohort. 🪐 I'm not always consistent — I get lazy, I drift, I restart. But aerospace is the one thing I keep coming back to, and when it matters to me, I show up fully. Some of what that's looked like: ✦ Contributing to real astrophysics data through 𝐍𝐀𝐒𝐀'𝐬 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐱𝐲 𝐙𝐨𝐨 ✦ Completed 𝐒𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐫'𝐬 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐠 𝐈𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐨𝐫 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐞 (YIIC 5.0) ✦ Deep into my first research project — projectile motion in Python ✦ Next up: open-source contribution Longer term, I want to work in 𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐞 — not just for the career, but because I want what I build to actually mean something for the country. Off the clock: I draw, train, watch too much anime, pick up bits of Japanese along the way, and speak Bengali, Hindi, Marathi, and English — switching mid-thought depending on who I'm talking to. 🌊 I post when I actually have something worth saying. This community has shaped how far I've come, and I don't take that lightly — if you want to talk shop or just need someone to listen, I mean that. I'd love to connect with anyone with a story worth sharing — aerospace or not. Say hi, tell me yours. ✦

current.employer_linkedin_description: For more than 60 years, NASA has been breaking barriers to achieve the seemingly impossible—from walking on the Moon to pushing the boundaries of human spaceflight farther than ever before. We work in space and around the world in laboratories and wind tunnels, on airfields and in control rooms to explore some of life’s fundamental mysteries: What’s out there in space? How do we get there? And what can we learn that will make life better here on Earth?We are passionate professionals united by a common purpose: to pioneer the future in space exploration, scientific discovery and aeronautics research. Today, we continue NASA’s legacy of excellence and innovation through an unprecedented array of missions. We are developing the most advanced rockets and spacecraft ever designed, studying the Earth for answers to critical challenges facing our planet, improving the air transportation experience, and so much more.   Join us as we reach for new heights and reveal the unknown for the benefit of humanity.

Flowmingo is a free AI interviewer for recruiters and hiring teams. You send one link; each applicant takes a structured, conversational first-round interview in their own time, in any of 60+ languages, and the AI asks a follow-up when an answer misses. Every interview is scored the moment it ends: you get the recording, the full transcript and a report rated 0-10 per criterion, with written reasons, strengths and gaps, and a rank among everyone who took the same interview. Around the interview sit CV evaluation, screening questions, skills tests and an applicant tracker, with REST API, webhooks and MCP on every plan. Screening is never metered. The Free plan is $0 forever, with unlimited interviews and unlimited seats; Starter is $49 a month and Growth $99 a month for longer video retention, your own branding and downloads. Sign-up is self-serve, with no card and no sales call.

Spring Fest, popularly known as SF, is the annual social & cultural festival of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur held during the month of January in the spring semester. The Spring Fest is held for 4 nights and 3 days on the weekend closest to 26 January, India's Republic Day.During the fest, students from IIT Kharagpur and from different colleges all over the country participate in a plethora of socio-cultural activities. Most of these are day events that involve dramatics, music and dance competitions, fine-arts contests, quizzes, and other literary events. Other non-competition-based events include Star-Talk which involves talks/conferences by eminent personalities from a variety of fields.The evenings are notable for "Star-Nites" — the biggest events in Spring Fest which usually involve live concerts by some of the most famous musicians and bands in South Asia. The genres of music are wide and varied and involve pop, rock, and fusion bands. Famous Indian artists like Pritam, Kailash Kher, KK, Shaan, Sunidhi Chauhan, Shankar Mahadevan and classical performers such as Pandit Debashish Bhattacharya, Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia,  Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt have performed here. Bands like Kryptos, Parikrama, Euphoria, Indian Ocean, Strings, etc. have also been performing here.International bands like Breathe, the Floyd Sound, Led Zepplica and TesseracT have also performed on the famous Spring Fest stage.

Edyant is a deep-tech AI governance company founded in 2025.We benchmark large language models and AI systems across 15 ethical dimensions — including moral reasoning, bias and fairness, safety, privacy, transparency, accountability, cultural diversity, and institutional governance. Our evaluations go beyond capability: we measure how AI reasons, who it impacts, and whether it can be held responsible.Through Edyant Labs, our open-source research arm, we build and publish frameworks designed to strengthen ethics, transparency, and accountability in real-world AI systems — built to be adopted, audited, and extended by the broader community.Through GRACE (Global Repository of AI Consensus), we publish a living, versioned AI governance standard built from multi-stakeholder consensus — giving academia, enterprises, and policymakers a shared reference for ethical AI development and deployment.Through our Consensus platform, we collect statements and positions on AI ethics and governance from individuals, researchers, institutions, and policymakers worldwide — the foundation that shapes and evolves GRACE over time.We collaborate with academic institutions, enterprises, and policymakers to advance global AI governance. Our work sits at the intersection of technical evaluation, open-source development, and policy — because responsible AI requires all three.Our name comes from the Sanskrit udyant (उद्यन्त) — meaning "that which rises." We believe responsible AI should rise from human values, not just human capability.edyant.com
current.employee_description:
Edyant is a technology company building foundational frameworks for ethical, explainable, and embodied artificial intelligence. We focus on AI systems that operate in the real world. Physical machines designed to reason, act, and adapt with responsibility and accountability.

Our frameworks make machine behavior interpretable, auditable, and aligned with human values, even in complex, dynamic environments.

Edyant redefines physical AI as a trustworthy collaborator rather than a black-box tool. Our work lays the foundation for intelligent machines that can safely operate alongside people, make principled decisions, and earn long-term trust in real-world applications.

current.employer_linkedin_description: DoraDAO is a non-profit community on a mission to make emerging tech accessible, inclusive, and human, not just for hardcore tech experts, but for everyone. (60k+ members from over 15+ countries 🇯🇵🇮🇳🇺🇸🇸🇬🇨🇳 🇳🇵 🇮🇩 🇵🇭 🇻🇳 🇪🇺  🇷🇺 🇱🇰 and beyond are coming together. )Origin story of DoraDAODoraDAO was born from a simple but uncomfortable realization.We kept seeing opportunities moving fast across the world global hackathons, grants, fellowships, early-stage experiments but the bridge to access them wasn’t built for everyone. Especially not for builders, creators, and communities in India and across emerging markets.So DoraDAO started as that missing bridge.A place designed to connect India with global opportunities and just as importantly, to help global ecosystems understand and work with India in a real, grounded way. Not as an afterthought. Not as a checkbox market. But as a living, contributing force.Over time, that bridge grew wider.And everything we build today still comes back to that first belief:Opportunity should travel both way...Story behind the NAME..The idea behind the name DoraDAO is actually pretty simple, and a little nostalgic. It comes from Dora the Explorer, that one character who never hesitated to ask questions. No matter how obvious, basic, or “silly” they might seem, Dora questioned everything without fear, without embarrassment, and without worrying about judgment.That curiosity stuck with us. That’s how DoraDAO came to life.The DoraDAO UmbrellaDoraDAO acts as the parent ecosystem, bringing together a set of premium, purpose-built initiatives under one umbrella.Socials...Here’s everything you need to represent yourself and the community online:Website: www.doradao.xyzLinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/doradao/Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/connectdoradao/Twitter : https://x.com/connectdoradaoSubstack : https://doradao.substack.comLuma : https://luma.com/connectdoradao

past.employer_linkedin_description: GSoC 25, or Google Summer of Code 2025, is a global program that encourages students to contribute to open source software development. It offers students the opportunity to gain practical experience by working on real-world projects under the guidance of experienced mentors from various open-source organizations. The program aims to bring more contributors into the open-source community and provide them with valuable skills and experience in software development. Key aspects of GSoC 25:Open Source Focus:GSoC 25 is specifically designed to introduce students to the world of open-source software development. Mentorship:Participants are paired with mentors from open-source organizations who guide them through their projects. Real-World Experience:GSoC provides a platform for students to work on tangible projects, gaining practical experience in areas like testing, version control, and distributed development. Global Program:GSoC is a global initiative, attracting participants from all over the world. Timeline:The typical coding period for GSoC projects is 12 weeks, but it can be extended to a maximum of 22 weeks with mentor approval. Student Stipends:Participants receive a stipend to support their involvement in the program. Community Building:GSoC fosters a strong community of developers, encouraging collaboration and knowledge sharing. How to participate:Find an Organization:Explore the list of participating organizations and their projects. Prepare a Proposal:Develop a compelling project proposal outlining your skills and the work you plan to do. Connect with Mentors:Engage with mentors from your chosen organization to refine your proposal and discuss your project. Contribute:Once selected, actively contribute to your project and collaborate with your mentor. Your Daily Schedule to Crack GSoC 2025! | Syed Imtiyaz AliGSoC 25 is a fantastic opportunity for students to gain valuable open-source experience, build their skills, and contribute!

You have the idea but don't know how to present it?

That's where I come in! ✧

From ghosting people to ghostwriting for founders,
life really did come full circle.

If you’re a founder who wants to show up consistently on LinkedIn without sounding forced or salesy, we’ll get along well.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) was founded in 1909 as a result of the joint efforts of Jamsetji Nusserwanji Tata, the Government of India, and the Maharaja of Mysore. In 1886, Jamsetji Tata conceived of a university of science that would work for the benefit of India, and in 1898 created an endowment for establishing such an institution. The Government of India then took up the effort, and, in consultation with scientists in England and in India, decided to locate the Institute in Bengaluru, where the Maharaja of Mysore, Shri Krishnaraja Wodeyar IV, donated 372 acres of land. The Institute was formally vested in 1909, the foundation stone was laid in 1911, and the first batch of students started their studies in the same year.Over the last century, IISc has become the premier institute for advanced scientific and technological research and education in India. Beginning with 2 departments and 21 students in 1911, today IISc has 39 departments, units, or centres, 3500 students, and about 500 academic and scientific staff, supported by 600 administrative personnel. About 2200 students are in various PhD programs, almost 900 are enrolled for various Masters degrees, whereas about 400 are registered in the newly established, research oriented, four-year Bachelor of Science (Research) programme.In recent years, the Institute has vigorously promoted interdisciplinary research. New centres such as the CiSTUP, the Robert Bosch Centre for Cyber Physical Systems and a new Centre for Brain Research (funded by a large private endowment) are expected to conduct translational research in their respective areas, in order to better connect with industry and society. With the recent construction of modern buildings, acquisition of new research facilities, and induction of a large number of new faculty members, the Institute can look forward to an era of high productivity, increasing impact, and rising prominence in the world.

Young ICCA is a world-wide arbitration knowledge and skills network for young practitioners, established in 2010. It aims to:• provide a forum for young students and professionals to exchange ideas about international arbitration;• provide young professionals interested in dispute resolution with access to each other and to the international arbitration community;• promote the use of arbitration and other forms of dispute resolution by introducing new practitioners from all corners of the globe into the practice of arbitration.Participation in Young ICCA is open to law students, faculty members and young practitioners. The United States Institute of Peace is a premier peacebuilding organization. Congress founded USIP in 1984 as an independent nonprofit corporation dedicated to promoting peace by preventing, mitigating and resolving violent conflict abroad.For over 40 years, USIP has provided those working for peace with proven approaches, practical policy research and a platform to convene diverse stakeholders. Because of USIP’s independent, nonpartisan status, it is a trusted intermediary and neutral interlocutor, able to convene and facilitate global peacebuilding efforts.USIP’s staff work at the Institute’s Washington, DC headquarters and on the ground in some of the world’s most dangerous regions. In pursuit of its mission, the Institute:- Develops tools and resources based on research and offers expert trainings for peacebuilders, including U.S. and foreign peace negotiators, mediators, diplomats and others so they are better equipped to work together to end destabilizing conflicts.- Designs field-tested peacebuilding plans, analysis and strategic gaming exercises for U.S. and foreign practitioners.- Serves the public by connecting them with resources on America’s role, heritage and commitment to peace.- Sends peacebuilding specialists to work with counterparts around the world to reduce conflict and advance peace.In connection with its research, education and training activities, USIP hosts and engages with a range of stakeholders who are committed to working for peace or learning about nonviolent resolution of conflict, including members of Congress, religious leaders, students, veterans, and leaders from around the world.

The Supreme Court of India is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India, the highest constitutional court, with the power of constitutional review. Consisting of the Chief Justice of India and 30 other judges, it has extensive powers in the form of original, appellate and advisory jurisdictions. As the final court of appeal of the country, it takes up appeals primarily against verdicts of the High Courts of various states of the Union and other courts and tribunals. It safeguards fundamental rights of citizens and settles disputes between various governments in the country. As an advisory court, it hears matters which may specifically be referred to it under the Constitution by the President of India. It also may take cognizance of matters on its own, without anyone drawing its attention to them. The law declared by the Supreme Court becomes binding on all courts within India.

The National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC), India is a quasi-judicial commission in India which was set up in 1988 under the Consumer Protection Act of 1986. Its head office is in New Delhi. The Commission is headed by a sitting or a retired Judge of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India or a sitting or a retired Chief Justice of an Hon'ble High Court, in terms of Rule 3(12)(a) of the Tribunal (Conditions of Service) Rules, 2021.     Section 21 of the Consumer Protection Act, 1986 posits that the National Commission shall have jurisdiction:- to entertain a complaint valued more than two crore and also have Appellate and Revisional jurisdiction from the orders of State Commissions or the District fora as the case may be.      Section 23 of the Consumer Protection Act, 1986, provides that any person aggrieved by an order of NCDRC may prefer an Appeal against such order to the Supreme Court of India within a period of 30 days.

The Supreme Court of India is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India, the highest constitutional court, with the power of constitutional review. Consisting of the Chief Justice of India and 30 other judges, it has extensive powers in the form of original, appellate and advisory jurisdictions. As the final court of appeal of the country, it takes up appeals primarily against verdicts of the High Courts of various states of the Union and other courts and tribunals. It safeguards fundamental rights of citizens and settles disputes between various governments in the country. As an advisory court, it hears matters which may specifically be referred to it under the Constitution by the President of India. It also may take cognizance of matters on its own, without anyone drawing its attention to them. The law declared by the Supreme Court becomes binding on all courts within India.

நமது யாவரும் கேளீர் திறன் வளர் சங்கம், தமிழ்நாடு அரசு மற்றும் இந்திய அரசின் MSME திட்டத்தின் கீழும் பதிவு செய்யப்பட்டு அனுமதி பெற்ற தன்னார்வல தமிழ்சார்ந்த சமூக சேவை நோக்கம் கொண்ட இளைஞர்களால் ஏற்படுத்தப்பட்ட அமைப்பாகும். மதுரை உலக தமிழ்ச் சங்கத்தின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ உறுப்பினராக மேலும் இணைத்தது மட்டுமின்றி, உள்நாட்டு மற்றும் பன்னாட்டு அளவிலான தமிழ் சங்கங்கள், கல்லூரிகள், அறக்கட்டளைகள் மற்றும் அமைப்புகளுடன் இணைந்து பல பணிகளை மேற்கொண்டு வருகிறது.நமது குழுவில் மாதந்தோறும் இணையவழியில் பன்னாட்டு அளவிலான திறன்வளர் போட்டிகள் எவ்வித கட்டணமுமின்றி நடத்தப்பட்டு, பல்வேறு தரப்பினரின் தனித்திறன்களை வெளிக்கொணரும் களமாக மட்டுமின்றி, வாரந்தோறும் பன்னாட்டு அளவிலான திறனறித்தேர்வுகளையும், கருத்தரங்களையும் நடத்திவருகிறது.இதனோடு மட்டுமில்லாமல், அறிவே ஆற்றல் எனும் தத்துவத்தை முன்மொழியும் வகையில் திறன் வளர் வகுப்புகளும், எண்ணங்களே எழுத்துகளாய் எனும் முனைப்பில் வாசகர் பக்கம் எனும் திட்டக்கூறும் மட்டுமின்றி பல திறன் வளர், அறிவு, தனித்திறன் மற்றும் தமிழ் சார்ந்த பல நடவடிக்கைகளில் ஈடுபட்டு வருகிறது.செயல்பாடுகள் / திட்டங்கள்1.மாதந்தோறும் இணையவழி திறன் வளர் போட்டிகள்.2.வாரந்தோறும் திறன் வளர் திறனறி தேர்வுகள்.3.தனித்திறன் மேம்பாட்டு சான்றிதழ் மற்றும் பட்டய வகுப்புகள்.4.எழுத்து திறன்களை ஊக்குவிக்கும் வகையில் வாசகர் பக்கம்.5.வாசிக்கும் திறனை வளப்படுத்தும் வகையில் வாசிப்பை சுவாசிப்போம்.6.தினந்தோறும் அன்றைய நாளின் சிறப்புகளை எடுத்துரைத்தல் மற்றும் அறிவுசார் குறிப்புகள் வழங்குதல்.7.சிறப்பு அழைப்பாளர்களை கொண்டு தமிழ் வளர் &தன்னம்பிக்கை கருத்தரங்கங்கள் / பட்டிமன்றங்கள் / பேச்சரங்கங்கள் மற்றும் கவியரங்ககள்8.காலைப்பொழுதை கலைநயமாக்கிட கோலங்கள் மற்றும் பங்கேற்பாளர்களின் தனித்திறன்களை தரணியேற்றும் வகையில் திறன் நிகழ்ச்சிகள். #யாவரும்கேளீர்திறன்வளர்சங்கம்#yavarum_kelir_skill_development_association#yavarumkelirsda

Christ University was formerly Christ College (Autonomous) affiliated to Bangalore University. Established in July 1969, Christ College became the most preferred educational institution in the city of Bangalore within the first three decades. From 1990 onwards it scaled  from heights to heights. By the introduction of innovative and modern curriculum, insistence on academic discipline, imparting of Holistic Education and with the help of the creative and dedicated staff, Christ College  has been continually rated among the top 10 educational institutions of the country. It has the rare distinction to be the first institution in Karnataka to be accredited by National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) UGC for quality education. On 7 October 2004, UGC has conferred Autonomy to Christ College (No. F.13-1/2004).On May 20, 2005, it became the first College in South India to be reaccredited with A+ by NAAC. UGC  has identified it as an Institution with Potential for Excellence in June 2006.July 22, 2008 is the most glorious day in the history of the institution. Under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, Ministry of Human Resources Development of the Union Government of India, vide Notification No. F. 9-34/2007-U.3(A), has declared it a Deemed to be University, in the name and style of Christ University.

This system integrates:* The Four Money Quadrants (4MQ): A non-judgmental diagnostic tool for understanding behavioural styles . * Money Decision Drivers (KMDM): An explanatory model decoding the psychological and environmental factors behind financial choices . * The 3D Identity Model: A developmental approach linking past, present, and future aspirations to cultivate purpose-driven habits.This framework is delivered through a comprehensive, evidence-based curriculum, grounded in academic research. Quark has been a major technical festival in the country since its inception. From its modest beginnings in 2006, Quark morphed into a national-level festival in its 2008 version. Since then, Quark has consistently seen participation from all leading colleges across India. Quark usually features various events pertaining to the different engineering branches as well as the pure sciences.The Quark logo highlights how Quark as a festival will never stop growing. The spirit of innovation and progress is reflected in the way Quark has constantly brought something new and wonderful to offer. In lieu of this, the left half of the new logo appears like a blueprint or something always under construction. past.employer_linkedin_description: Shivaji University, established in 1962, is named after the Great Maratha Warrior and founder of the Maratha empire Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. It was inaugurated on 18th November, 1962 by Dr. Radhakrishnan, the then President of India. One of the major objectives behind foundation of this University was to cater to the regional needs of South Maharashtra. The jurisdiction of the University is spread over three districts viz. Kolhapur, Sangli and Satara with strength of about 3,00,000 students studying in 280 affiliated colleges and recognised institutes. This region of Maharashtra boasts of rich and varied socio-cultural heritage. Under the innovative and socially reformist leadership of Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj, the princely ruler of Kolhapur, the city had become at the beginning of this century, a focal point of educational opportunities for all classes and communities of South-Western Maharashtra, and northern parts of neighbouring Karnataka. This is also land of Karmaveer Bhaurao Patil, who struggled for taking education to the masses by his innovative 'Earn and Learn' scheme. When the University was founded by the Shivaji University Act of 1962, the objectives set before the University included making opportunities of higher education accessible to rural youth, conducting fundamental and applied research in the field of science and humanities to ensure regional growth and development.In 1962 the University started functioning with 34 affiliated colleges and about 14000 students with 5 Post-graduate Departments on the campus. Today the number of affiliated colleges has gone upto 280 and students strength upto 3,00,000 with 34 Postgraduate Departments on campus. The University imparts education in 10 major faculties of Arts, Social Science, Science, Commerce, Education, Fine Arts, Law, Medicine, Ayurvedic Medicine, Engineering and Technology.

past.employer_linkedin_description: DoraDAO is a non-profit community on a mission to make emerging tech accessible, inclusive, and human, not just for hardcore tech experts, but for everyone. (60k+ members from over 15+ countries 🇯🇵🇮🇳🇺🇸🇸🇬🇨🇳 🇳🇵 🇮🇩 🇵🇭 🇻🇳 🇪🇺  🇷🇺 🇱🇰 and beyond are coming together. )Origin story of DoraDAODoraDAO was born from a simple but uncomfortable realization.We kept seeing opportunities moving fast across the world global hackathons, grants, fellowships, early-stage experiments but the bridge to access them wasn’t built for everyone. Especially not for builders, creators, and communities in India and across emerging markets.So DoraDAO started as that missing bridge.A place designed to connect India with global opportunities and just as importantly, to help global ecosystems understand and work with India in a real, grounded way. Not as an afterthought. Not as a checkbox market. But as a living, contributing force.Over time, that bridge grew wider.And everything we build today still comes back to that first belief:Opportunity should travel both way...Story behind the NAME..The idea behind the name DoraDAO is actually pretty simple, and a little nostalgic. It comes from Dora the Explorer, that one character who never hesitated to ask questions. No matter how obvious, basic, or “silly” they might seem, Dora questioned everything without fear, without embarrassment, and without worrying about judgment.That curiosity stuck with us. That’s how DoraDAO came to life.The DoraDAO UmbrellaDoraDAO acts as the parent ecosystem, bringing together a set of premium, purpose-built initiatives under one umbrella.Socials...Here’s everything you need to represent yourself and the community online:Website: www.doradao.xyzLinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/doradao/Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/connectdoradao/Twitter : https://x.com/connectdoradaoSubstack : https://doradao.substack.comLuma : https://luma.com/connectdoradao

basic_profile.summary:
I’m M. Sri Vyshnavi, an Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) student with a strong passion for Embedded Systems and VLSI design. My academic journey has fueled my curiosity about how hardware and software come together to create intelligent systems, from microcontrollers to chip-level architecture.

I have developed a solid foundation in digital electronics, microprocessors, and system design, and I enjoy working on projects that involve low-level programming, circuit simulations, and hardware-software integration. I'm particularly fascinated by the role VLSI plays in shaping next-gen technologies and how embedded systems are driving innovations in automation, IoT, and smart devices.
Currently, I’m focused on expanding my hands-on experience through internships, online courses, and practical projects. I thrive in collaborative environments and am eager to contribute to real-world challenges in the semiconductor and embedded tech industry.
Looking forward to opportunities that allow me to grow, innovate, and make an impact in the world of electronics!

Interact is an international organization of service that fosters leadership and responsible citizenship, and promotes international understanding and peace. Interact is a club for youth ages 12-18 who want to connect with others in their community or school. Interact club members have fun while carrying out service projects and learning about the world. The name “Interact” was created by combining the words “international” and “action.” Interact clubs are sponsored by Rotary clubs and Interact clubs organize at least two service projects a year: one that benefits their community and one that encourages international understanding. While Interact clubs receive guidance from individual Rotary clubs, they govern and support themselves and are included in Rotary International’s “Youth Services” Avenue of Service. Interact has over 250, 000 youth in more than 11,000 clubs  in over 120 countries and geographical areas . Brazil, India, the Philippines, and the United States have the highest number of interact clubs. The first interact club was at Melbourne High School in 1962. It had 23 members to begin with and was created by Harold T. Thomas.

The Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) is a non-profit organization run by students of IIT Bombay. We create awareness among students & professionals about Entrepreneurship through our various programs like workshops, speaker sessions, business plan competitions, and other such events. We support upcoming Entrepreneurs by providing them necessary resources such as mentors, consultancy, seed funds and networking. We conduct Asia's largest B-Model competition Eureka! with prize money of INR 26 Lakhs and incentives worth 2 crores. The last edition of Eureka! received 43,000+ entries from India and abroad. Eight tracks were formed to allow startups to compete in their own domain. Over the years, Eureka! has received huge attention from national and international media being featured in reputed newspapers like Hindustan Times, Financial Express and Indian Express. E-Summit is the annual flagship event of E-Cell IIT Bombay organized in December each year. The purpose of the summit is to bring together all the stakeholders of the entrepreneurship ecosystem. The summit has an attendance of 50,000+ people, most of them being professionals, entrepreneurs and college students. The two-day event is filled with activities like speaker sessions, on-the-spot funding competitions, networking arena, and other events to encourage the idea of starting up among the attendees. The summit has had speaker sessions from great entrepreneurs like Travis Kalanick, Kiran Majumdar Shaw, Sachin Bansal, Ritesh Agarwal, Bhavish Aggarwal, Bharat Desai, and personalities like Rajat Sharma, Nandan Nilekani, Amitabh Kant, Anurag Kashyap and Ashish Chanchalani.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Viswam.ai, is an initiative dedicated to leveraging AI for the empowerment and development of the Global South, with focus on the inclusion of marginalized  underserved communities. A collaborative effort between Swecha and IIIT Hyderabad, it envisions creating innovative, inclusive, and accessible AI technologies that can power grassroot solutions. Fostering linguistic, cultural, and social diversity of the regions. Thru cutting-edge research, skilling youth in AI technologies, and foundations to help building solutions for real-world challenges faced by communities.A key priority of Viswam.ai is to build for resource-poor languages/areas, that often lack digital resources &  quality datasets required for building AI models. The initiative focuses on developing tools and techniques to compile datasets, and then build effective algorithms with alternatives that reduce computational costs without compromising performance; ensuring that AI solutions are both accessible and sustainable. Starting with AI tools for local languages such as speech recognition and natural language processing models, going on to build purpose specific LLMs.  These efforts will contribute to fostering inclusivity in AI. Viswam.ai will also embark on research needed, like developing Bit LLMs and Bit embeddings to enhance efficiency and accessibility for resource-constrained environments. TTS  analysis to identify solutions that require minimal GPU resources while providing greater control over output. Efforts in semantic chunking and reducing the size of semantic search models aim to make AI-driven information retrieval faster and more scalable. Supported by creative approaches such as building "Chandamama Kathalu" SLMs, and Speech Recognition systems designed to preserve and promote regional traditions and language accessibility.Foundational datasets and models will be at the core. Like collecting extensive ASR datasets to improve the accuracy and adaptability of speech recognition tools.

Eight tracks were formed to allow startups to compete in their own domain. The summit has an attendance of 50,000+ people, most of them being professionals, entrepreneurs and college students. The two-day event is filled with activities like speaker sessions, on-the-spot funding competitions, networking arena, and other events to encourage the idea of starting up among the attendees. current.employer_linkedin_description: National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur, earlier known as Regional Institute of Technology was established on 15th August 1960 as a joint venture of Government of India and the Government of Bihar in the chain of RECs (Regional Engineering College) in India with the aim to impart technical education at B.Tech. M.Sc., MCA, and Ph.D levels.The foundation stone of RIT (REC) Jamshedpur was laid by Dr. Srikrishna Sinha, the then chief minister of Bihar , with the aim of nurturing talent and setting high standards of education and excellence. The Institute is fully funded and governed by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), Government of India. On 15 August 2007, NIT Jamshedpur was given the status of the Institute of National Importance through an Act of the Parliament known as the NIT Act-2007. The Institute has 12 departments including engineering, science and humanities. The Institute, with 200+ faculty, 3000 students, 150 administrative and supporting staff, is a self-contained campus. It is located on the outskirts of Jamshedpur on 320 acres of sprawling, rolling hilly, wooded land. It combines natural beauty of countryside with urban glamour of an industrial area. The flowing river and picturesque backdrop of low hills on one side and large tracks of forest on the other make the 320 acres of rolling campus an ideal place for higher learning and research. It has been growing from strength to strength ever since it was established in 1960.There is refreshing development on every front. The institute has achieved impressive placement for its students, with top industrial houses and software companies recruiting the students in large numbers.Other than B.Tech. the institute also offers M.Tech,M.Sc. The Unit- I of TNPL at Kagithapuram, Karur district was commissioned in October 1985 with an installed capacity of 90,000 TPA of Newsprint/Fine Paper, in a single machine. Over a period of time, TNPL has added two more paper machines, besides upgrading the existing Paper machine. The increased production capacity of 400,000 TPA of writing and printing papers has made TNPL as one of the largest bagasse- a residue of sugar cane, as primary raw material based paper mill in the world. With an increased demand, the company has expanded the pulping capacity by way of installing new chemical hardwood line, upgrading the chemical bagasse pulp line and setting up a new deinked pulp line besides adopting ECF bleaching in all the chemical pulp lines. Simultaneously, the company has also increased the power plant capacity to meet the steam and energy requirement of the expanded mill. All the three modern high-speed paper machines are capable of producing varities of Writing and Printing papers and are equipped with state-of-the art automation to ensure consistent quality. The Company has earned a reputation as a pre-eminent player of manufacturing paper from bagasse having a world-wide creditability in the trade. Today, TNPL Unit-I is self sufficient in terms of power and pulp.

Delhi Technological University (DTU), formerly known as the Delhi College of Engineering (DCE), is a premier public university located in New Delhi, India. It is Delhi's first Engineering college and among those few engineering colleges of India which were set up before independence. It was established in 1941 as Delhi Polytechnic and was under the control of the Government of India.DTU is regarded as one of the top 10 engineering colleges in India along with the first generation IITs.It is the alma mater of highly distinguished world class engineers and professionals, which include the "Father of Pentium Chip" Vinod Dham, Vijay Shekhar Sharma, the founder & CEO of PayTM, Sushant Singh Rajput, famous Bollywood actor, Praveen Sinha, Co-founder of Jabong, Rohit Chadda, Co-founder of FoodPanda, Promod Haque, the world's known venture capitalist, Raj Soin, the avionics wizards of US and a top ranking techno entrepreneur of Ohio, Durgadas Agrawal, the renowned techno-entrepreneur of Houston, to name a few.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Yuvaan, the official literary fest of Delhi Technological University, laid the foundation of a legacy with its premier edition in 2017. past.employer_linkedin_description: Our StoryIn 2020, when COVID-19 disrupted livelihoods overnight, we saw families struggle for basic necessities. Pledge A Smile Foundation was started to respond fast—mobilising support, sourcing essentials, and delivering relief where it was needed most.As the immediate crisis eased, the underlying challenges remained. Hunger, seasonal distress, and education drop-offs didn’t stop with the pandemic. So we stayed—evolving from emergency relief into sustained community support.Our MissionTo create dependable, dignity-first support systems for vulnerable families—so no one is left behind due to circumstances beyond their control.Our VisionA society where every child and family has access to essentials—food security, seasonal protection, and a real chance to learn and grow.What We Do (Our Focus Areas)1) Hunger Relief — Project SEVAWe provide essential food material to families facing food insecurity through planned distribution and last-mile delivery.2) Seasonal Relief — Project RAAHATWe support vulnerable communities with winter essentials to reduce cold-related hardship and health risks.3) Education & Child Welfare — Project MUSKAANWe work to support children through access, continuity, and learning support—especially where families face economic barriers that push children out of school.

The Bharat Scouts and Guides is the national Scouting and Guiding association of India. The Bharat Scouts and Guides is a Registered Society under Societies Registrations Act. It is totally voluntary, non-political and secular Organisation.Scouting was founded in India in 1909 as an overseas branch of the Scout Association and became a member of the World Organization of the Scout Movement in 1938. Guiding in India started in 1911 and was amongst the founder members of the World Association of Girl Guides and Girl Scouts in 1928, also covering present-day Bangladesh and Pakistan at that time.Scout and Guide units are separate although they have some coeducational activities such as Jamborees, rallies, and conferences. Handicapped boys and girls also participate in the Scouting program.The Scout emblem incorporates a wheel with twenty-four spokes, known as the Ashoka Chakra, taken from the Ashoka pillar at Sarnath, in the green-and-saffron colors of the flag of India.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The demand-supply gap scenario, exponential opportunities and dynamic challenges in the 21st century call for a change in our thinking on engineering practice and education. A transformation on the current engineering education is the need of the hour. Growth of new knowledge together with rapidly evolving technological skills, the skill to communicate across disciplines, the ability to lead team-centered projects, contextualised problem formulation, and hands-on experience are the present demands of the global industry. On contrary to the present demands, students churned out from engineering colleges are not equipped to meet the current industry needs due to the growing gap between engineering practice, education and research which requires a lot of concern. As a timely response, it is this concern for the student that has led Aditya to initiate Technical Hub: a perfect launch pad to the job world. Technical Hub trains students in various disciplines beyond technological labels besides equipping them with skills and creativity required for advancement in their careers. Through its various programs Technical Hub provides adequate opportunities for an unmatched knowledge base by imparting all necessary skills to students and makes them job ready.

The Mountaineering & Trekking Club founded in 1971 was the forerunner of the Himalayan Explorers' Club (HEC). Between 1971 & 1974 the Institute Sports Association nurtured the Mountaineering & Trekking Club which fostered all mountaineering, trekking and outward bound activities amongst science, engineering and professional student community of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.In July 1975 the first major high altitude expedition in the Himalayas was organized successfully in joint collaboration with the Nainital Mountaineering Club, Nainital. With effect from the academic session of1975-76, the Mountaineering and Trekking Club was rechristened as the Himalayan Explorers' Club (HEC). Between July 1976 and August 1977 , the HEC organized a series of three major expeditions in the Garhwal Himalayas (to Mt. Rudragaigra (19500 ft) in July 1976, to Mt. Thelu (20,000 ft) in October 1976 and to Mt. Kedar Dome (23,000 ft) in June 1977) in which as many as 35 students of the University of Roorkee participated.In the month of October 2017, HEC resumed its legacy of organizing Mountaineering Expedition by organizing Khal Pass Expedition (19500 ft) after a gap of 40 years. The club has taken a social initiative 'Mountain Cleaning Drive' effective from April 2017.

One of our flagship activities has been the conduct of an international conference series on “Advances in Technology and Business Potential of New Drug Delivery Systems”, annually or biannually, since inception. This conference brings together a galaxy of international scientists from industry and academia as well as CRS Inc office bearers.The CRSIC actively promotes post graduate student research through poster presentations, best poster awards and travel grants. The CRSIC also offers a platform for engaging industry through industry specific workshops and solicits collaborations based on Corporate Social Responsibility activities.

BIT, Sindri was started as College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering in 1949 at Patna. After one year it was shifted to Sindri on 17th November 1950 and thus BIT Sindri was born with a Principal, three Professors and sixty Students in a simple ceremony with a cup of tea on the dining table. The institute grew and flourished rapidly during the early days under the dynamic leadership of Prof. D.L.Deshpande, the then Director[1950-61], who is regarded as the architect of the institute.The institute is located at a distance of 28 kms from Dhanbad railway station linked by rail as well as road. It has a sprawling campus of about 400 acres of land near the eastern bank of river Damodar. There are 25 hostels in the campus, separate hostels for boys and girls, catering the residential requirements of around 3000 undergraduate, postgraduate and research students. The institute is fully residential for students as well as teaching and non-teaching staff.The institute is controlled administratively by the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of Jharkhand, Ranchi and academically it is affiliated to Vinoba Bhave University, Hazaribag for conducting examinations and awarding degrees. All courses are approved by All India Council of Technical Education and most of the undergraduate programs are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation, New Delhi.The main aim of the institute is to cater to the needs of the nation for technological manpower development and research programs comparable to the best of the world. past.employer_linkedin_description: India's largest Education Finance Platform- WeMakeScholars was founded in the year 2015 as a Scholarship search Engine wherein we created the world’s biggest database of international scholarships. The initiative is funded and supported by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Govt. of India under the Digital India Campaign in association with BITS Pilani where WeMakeScholars was incubated as a start-up.In 2016, Education loans support was initiated as a free-of-cost service. This service was started with public banks like State Bank of India, Bank of Baroda, etc but was later extended to Private banks and NBFCs.To conclude, WeMakeScholars helps study abroad aspirants arranging finance through Scholarships and Education Loans. The idea originated with the struggle the founders had, while searching for scholarships for their masters in 2012. Later, one received the prestigious UK Govt. Queen’s Diamond Jubilee Scholarship which fully funded his studies, including visa, travel, tuition fee, monthly stipend & a meeting with David Cameron (British PM) at 10 Downing Street. And, the other received “Developing Solutions Scholarship”. This was when they started an online community to fill the gap b/w opportunities and students. The community grew exponentially to 160K members in a year and members requested to build a dedicated platform to keep the content more organised. Hence, WeMakeScholars.com was born.WeMakeScholars has been endorsed by many Global Leaders including Helen Clark, former PM of New Zealand and current Admin of United Nations DP. past.employer_linkedin_description: The National Policy on Education-1986 envisaged setting up of residential schools, to be called Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas that would bring out the best of rural talent.It was felt that children with special talent or aptitude should be provided opportunities to progress at a faster pace by making good quality education available to them irrespective of their capacity to pay for it. Such education would enable students from rural areas to compete with their urban counterparts on an equal footing.The Navodaya Vidyalaya System which began as a unique experiment,is today unparalleled in the annals of school education in India and elsewhere. Its significance lies in the selection of talented rural children as the target group and the attempt to provide them quality education comparable to the best in a residential school system.

In 2011, SPIC MACAY was awarded the Rajiv Gandhi Sadbhavana award in recognition of its contribution to youth development.In the December of 2015, the 1st ever Winter National Convention was organized in the IIT Roorkee campus which saw 60+ events happening around-the-clock and a participation of around 1500 from volunteers from various chapters from all over India. Along with this, Virasat is a seven-day series of events which is organized every year,  during which a number of artists representing various art forms are hosted by the volunteers. Uttarayan is celebrated in the second week of January, which has the kite-flying event, heritage quiz as well as a movie being screened for the students of campus. SPIC MACAY celebrates Nishkaam Seva - the spirit of volunteerism – of giving selflessly without expectation, a value that is intrinsic to our culture and important to nurture in today's world.

Kshitij, the annual techno-management fest of IIT Kharagpur, stands as a symbol of innovation, intellect, and impact. Since its inception in 2004, Kshitij has provided a dynamic platform for young minds to showcase their technical prowess and management acumen on a global stage. Over the years, it has evolved into a festival of immense scale, drawing participants from across the globe and achieving milestones such as 8 million website clicks in a single edition, making [www.ktj.in](http://www.ktj.in) one of the largest student-run websites.The fest hosts a diverse array of competitions, workshops, and events certified by prestigious organizations like ACM, IEEE, INCOSE, ASHRAE, and IMechE, catering to a wide spectrum of interests in technology and management. Beyond competitions, Kshitij addresses pressing societal challenges through impactful social initiatives in collaboration with leading organizations such as UNICEF. The workshops, held nationwide, provide hands-on learning opportunities to nurture technical skills and ignite curiosity.Kshitij is also renowned for its stellar lineup of guest lectures by luminaries, awe-inspiring exhibitions, and electrifying megashows. Endorsed by globally respected entities like UNESCO, SAYEN, CEE, and Make in India, the fest continues to inspire and empower the next generation of leaders and innovators.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Documenting the creators, campuses, and communities shaping youth culture in India.CULSEQ takes its name from "Cultural Secretary", the student leader often at the heart of campus life, connecting people, ideas, events, and creative communities. Inspired by that role, CULSEQ exists to be the pulse of college culture, documenting the talent, stories, and movements shaping youth culture across India.We believe some of the most important stories in India are still unfolding inside college auditoriums, festival grounds, rehearsal rooms, student clubs, open mics, creator collectives, and campus communities. These are the spaces where future artists, entrepreneurs, performers, innovators, and cultural leaders first find their voice.For nearly a decade, our journey has been rooted in understanding youth culture from the inside. Through our earlier work as ATKT, we built relationships with hundreds of colleges, festivals, societies, and student creators across India, documenting talent long before it reached mainstream audiences.Today, CULSEQ expands that vision.We are building a living archive of Indian youth culture by documenting the creators, campuses, and communities that shape it. Through stories, interviews, event coverage, creator features, original content, and campus partnerships, we capture what young India is creating, discussing, performing, and celebrating right now.  Our network spans colleges, student organisations, cultural festivals, creators, artists, musicians, dancers, writers, filmmakers, entrepreneurs, and emerging communities across the country. Together, they form one of India's most dynamic cultural ecosystems.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The Birla Institute of Technology & Science (BITS), Pilani is a prestigious Indian university for higher education in science, technology and humanities. BITS Pilani has consistently ranked amongst the top universities in India. The acceptance rate of BITS Pilani is 1.47% making it the most selective university in India.The primary motive of BITS is to "train young men and women able and eager to create and put into action such ideas, methods, techniques and information". The Institute is a dream come true of its founder late Mr G.D.Birla - an eminent industrialist, a participant in Indian freedom struggle and a close associate of the Father of Indian Nation late Mr. Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (Mahatma Gandhi). What started in early 1900s as a small school, blossomed into a set of colleges for higher education, ranging from the Humanities to Engineering until 1964 when all these colleges amalgamated to culminate into a unique Indian University of International standing. This university was christened as the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, known to many as BITS, Pilani.Over the years, BITS has provided the highest quality technical education to students from all over India admitted on the basis of merit. Its graduates may be found throughout the world in all areas of engineering, science and commerce. BITS symbolizes the maturing of Indian technical ability and "can-do" entrepreneurial spirit, especially as derived from the private sector. BITS is located in the Vidya Vihar campus adjacent to the town of Pilani in Rajasthan.Admission is merit-based, as assessed by the online BITSAT examination. The fully residential institute is privately supported.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian School of Business (ISB) evolved from the need for a world-class business school in Asia. past.employer_linkedin_description: The Institute of Mental Health (IMH) is a 2,000-bed acute tertiary psychiatric hospital situated on a 23-hectare campus at Buangkok Green Medical Park. Set amidst serene surroundings, IMH offers a comprehensive range of psychiatric, rehabilitative and counselling services for children, adolescents, adults, and the elderly.IMH’s tradition of care started in 1928. We were the first mental hospital in Singapore, starting with some 1,000 patients. Since then, many advances have been made in treatment, training, and research. Our treatment integrates evidence-based therapies, supported by the departments of clinical psychology, nursing, occupational therapy, and medical social work, to provide holistic care for our patients. IMH is equipped with modern facilities, with 50 wards for inpatients and seven Specialist Outpatient Clinics.IMH also plays a key role in training the next generation of mental health professionals in Singapore. We train psychiatrists and mental health professionals through the NHG-AHPL Residency Programme for psychiatry and through collaborations with the local tertiary institutions.Join a healthcare community where your passion to care and heal creates meaningful impact every day. We're committed to adding years of healthy life to those we serve whilst nurturing your own wellbeing and career growth. Discover life-changing opportunities where your individual purpose aligns with our shared mission – where caring for others begins with caring for each other.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian School of Business (ISB) evolved from the need for a world-class business school in Asia. Established in 2001, the ISB has successfully put India on the global map of management education by pioneering several new trends in research, promoting innovation and training and nurturing young leaders who not only have an understanding of the developing economies but the society at large. With two state-of-the-art campuses in Hyderabad and Mohali, ISB provides opportunities to engage with the best of global management practice and thinking. In 2008, ISB became the youngest institution to be ranked among the Top 20 Global B-schools by the Financial Times, London, and since then has been ranked consistently among the top B-schools globally. A proficient pool of research-oriented resident and visiting faculty from top management institutions worldwide provides the essential thrust to ISB’s research milieu. ISB’s strong research acumen has helped produce knowledge and competencies to benefit industry and society, not only in India but across Asia and the rest of the world. Around the world, the School is represented by its network of 17,200+ alumni from the PGP and AMP suites, PGP,PGPMAX, PGPpro, PGP MFAB, AMPBA, AMPH, AMPI, AMPOS, and AMPPP, and the 50,000+ alumni of its Executive Education programmes.Whether it is through innovations in curricula to reflect the shifting business landscape or stimulating experiences and learning outside the classroom, the ISB is committed to providing the best avenue for management education and research to meet the growing need to develop young leaders who can manage global challenges.For more information on the School, visit www.isb.edu Follow us:Twitter: www.twitter.com/ISbeduFacebook: https://www.facebook.com/ISBedu/YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/isbindiaInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/isbindia/Blog: https://blogs.isb.edu/

basic_profile.name: Isha Ahuja
basic_profile.headline: COO’s Office @Zolo | Product | Growth | AI and Automations | Founder’s Office | Strategy
basic_profile.summary: The best products aren't built by accident—they're built by people who obsess over users, ask the right questions, and enjoy solving messy problems.That's what excites me.Over the past year, I've worked across Product, Founder's Office, Operations, and Growth, partnering with cross-functional teams to turn ambiguity into execution. From managing end-to-end product operations and collaborating with product managers to handling large-scale datasets, improving internal workflows, and using AI to automate repetitive processes, I've learned that great products are created through continuous iteration, strong execution, and deep user understanding.Some of the work I've been fortunate to do includes:• Managing the end-to-end lifecycle of data for 10L+ doctors—from collection and cleaning to validation and production deployment.• Working closely with Product and Engineering teams to coordinate product initiatives, manage Jira workflows, and support feature execution.• Conducting UX reviews, identifying friction points, and contributing ideas to improve product experiences.• Building AI-powered automations using tools like n8n, Claude, ChatGPT, Lovable, Supabase, and Vercel AI to streamline workflows and increase operational efficiency.• Contributing across strategy, operations, documentation, research, and execution in fast-moving startup environments where wearing multiple hats is the norm.I enjoy working at the intersection of product thinking, data, AI, user experience, and business strategy. Whether it's breaking down a complex problem, improving an existing workflow, or collaborating across teams to ship meaningful solutions, I'm motivated by creating products that genuinely solve user problems.I'm currently looking for opportunities in Product Management, Associate Product Management (APM), Product Analyst, Product Operations, and Founder's Office, where I can continue learning, take ownership, and build products that create real impact.If you're building something ambitious, I'd love to connect and contribute.

basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder & COO at India Accelerator | Founding Partner IA growth Funds
basic_profile.summary:
Abhay’s journey into the Indian startup ecosystem began at a time when it was still in its nascent stage. Since then, he has played a pivotal role in shaping its growth. 

Abhay brings 25+ years of deep operational and strategic experience with cross-functional leadership to drive India’s startup landscape. He is the Co-Founder and COO of India Accelerator, a multi-stage fund led accelerator, a proud member of the Global Accelerator Network (GAN) and an instrumental enabler of the Indian startup ecosystem. 

With acute business acumen, he manages multi-threaded priorities and spearheads the company’s strategic growth across coworking expansions, AIF management, finance, legal and compliance verticals. He is one of the central forces behind IA's evolution into a full-stack startup ecosystem enabler.
In addition, he balances investor relations, AIFs and regulatory alignment to build a future-ready infrastructure for startups to stay ahead in a fiercely competitive landscape. 

Currently, he is actively involved in crafting IA's robust ecosystem, which includes its own Venture Fund (Cat 1/2). His dedication to the fund's success is evident in his multifaceted role, driving the vision of IA towards becoming a leading force in startup investments and mentorship.

With a sharp strategic mind and an operator’s instinct, he continues to shape IA’s journey from a high-impact enabler to a powerhouse in the startup ecosystem. Under his leadership, it has not only become one of the fastest-growing accelerators in Asia but is also firmly on track to becoming India’s most powerful launchpad for iconic ventures.

When life doesn’t seem fair, when everything you touch seems to crumble before your eyes, what do you do? Do you shout and scream? Do you crawl in the darkest corner of your room and cry? Or do you fight back, forget what has happened and start again?Rewind back to 2004 when Dr. Jitender Aggarwal’s life and career, took a completely different turn. He started losing his vision due to a non-treatable concern- Macular Degeneration of retina and suddenly his career and life came to a halt. But he knew he can’t sit and mope."My vision was diminishing, but I kept on believing - it is the challenges only that strengthen you." Says Dr. Aggarwal. He learnt medical transcription and tried working out on everything that would come to his knowledge to support his family.One day, a thought dawned on him. "Weren't there, many others like me grappling with many disabilities? I had some kind of financial backup, several others didn't. Couldn’t I help a few others pick up what I was doing? People gave them charity, some even trained them but no one empowered them find sustainable jobs".On his quest to break barriers, Dr. Jitender Aggarwal founded Sarthak Educational Trust for people with disabilities in July 2008, with the aim of making lives of persons with disabilities Sarthak (successful), enabling them to become Masters of their own Destiny and finding its own success in theirs. It wasn’t an over-night thought, but a combination of personal loss and empathy towards fellow people with disabilities. As in his wife, Dr. Suman Aggarwal’s words- “With Adversity comes an opportunity”, and our founder made sure to mold it in the best way possible.Since last 14 years, Sarthak is committedly working for the people with disabilities, their families and communities to create sustainable change and make an inclusive India with equal dignity & respect for Divyangjans. Today we can say that Sarthak is a young yet successful NGO working towards mainstreaming Persons with disability.

basic_profile.name: Maninder Singh Bawa
basic_profile.headline: Evaluating Startups What Separates Real AI from Hype | CTO @ India Accelerator & Lawyered | Mentor | Teacher | BITS Pilani
basic_profile.summary:
I believe AI will do to legal services what UPI did to payments — make it instant, accessible, and invisible.
I'm building that future at Lawyered, where we just raised ₹8.5 Cr on Ideabaaz (the largest deal in Indian TV history). Our AI — LAILA — is a voice-first legal assistant helping drivers instantly understand if a challan is valid, what fine applies, and how to dispute it. No lawyer needed for the first interaction.
The numbers:
→ 2M+ legal cases resolved
→ 600,000+ vehicles protected
→ 99% resolution rate
→ ₹60Cr+ saved for fleet operators
But here's what excites me more than the metrics: we're proving that AI can work in low-trust, high-stakes domains — not just chatbots and content generation, but real decisions that affect people's livelihoods.
My AI thesis:
The next wave of AI isn't general-purpose assistants. It's vertical AI — deeply embedded in specific industries, trained on domain-specific data, solving problems that require regulatory and cultural context. India has unique opportunities here: legal-tech, agri-tech, healthcare, financial inclusion. The winners won't be those with the best models, but those with the best data moats and distribution.
What I do:
🔹 Build — CTO at Lawyered, architecting LAILA and LOTS247
🔹 Evaluate — CTO at India Accelerator, conducting technical due diligence on AI startups across 225+ portfolio companies (including unicorns like Ola)
🔹 Teach — Passionate about system design and helping engineers think architecturally
Previously: Director of Engineering at Delivery Hero (Singapore), Senior EM at Classplus (scaled to 4Cr+ DAUs), Software Consultant at McKinsey.
Background: MTech in Data Science & ML (BITS Pilani) | Deep Learning & TensorFlow Specializations
I write about: Applied AI in India, vertical AI opportunities, what separates AI startups that scale from those that don't, and lessons from evaluating 100+ tech startups.
DM me about: AI startup evaluation, legal-tech, scaling AI in production, architecture reviews.

basic_profile.name: Abhay Chawla
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder & COO at India Accelerator | Founding Partner IA growth Funds
basic_profile.summary:
Abhay’s journey into the Indian startup ecosystem began at a time when it was still in its nascent stage. Since then, he has played a pivotal role in shaping its growth. 

Abhay brings 25+ years of deep operational and strategic experience with cross-functional leadership to drive India’s startup landscape. He is the Co-Founder and COO of India Accelerator, a multi-stage fund led accelerator, a proud member of the Global Accelerator Network (GAN) and an instrumental enabler of the Indian startup ecosystem. 

With acute business acumen, he manages multi-threaded priorities and spearheads the company’s strategic growth across coworking expansions, AIF management, finance, legal and compliance verticals. He is one of the central forces behind IA's evolution into a full-stack startup ecosystem enabler.
In addition, he balances investor relations, AIFs and regulatory alignment to build a future-ready infrastructure for startups to stay ahead in a fiercely competitive landscape. 

Currently, he is actively involved in crafting IA's robust ecosystem, which includes its own Venture Fund (Cat 1/2). His dedication to the fund's success is evident in his multifaceted role, driving the vision of IA towards becoming a leading force in startup investments and mentorship.

With a sharp strategic mind and an operator’s instinct, he continues to shape IA’s journey from a high-impact enabler to a powerhouse in the startup ecosystem. Under his leadership, it has not only become one of the fastest-growing accelerators in Asia but is also firmly on track to becoming India’s most powerful launchpad for iconic ventures.

Abhay’s journey into the Indian startup ecosystem began at a time when it was still in its nascent stage. Since then, he has played a pivotal role in shaping its growth. 

Abhay brings 25+ years of deep operational and strategic experience with cross-functional leadership to drive India’s startup landscape. He is the Co-Founder and COO of India Accelerator, a multi-stage fund led accelerator, a proud member of the Global Accelerator Network (GAN) and an instrumental enabler of the Indian startup ecosystem.

Under his leadership, it has not only become one of the fastest-growing accelerators in Asia but is also firmly on track to becoming India’s most powerful launchpad for iconic ventures.
