basic_profile.name: Maninder Singh Bawa
basic_profile.headline: Evaluating Startups What Separates Real AI from Hype | CTO @ India Accelerator & Lawyered | Mentor | Teacher | BITS Pilani
basic_profile.summary:
I believe AI will do to legal services what UPI did to payments — make it instant, accessible, and invisible.
I'm building that future at Lawyered, where we just raised ₹8.5 Cr on Ideabaaz (the largest deal in Indian TV history). Our AI — LAILA — is a voice-first legal assistant helping drivers instantly understand if a challan is valid, what fine applies, and how to dispute it. No lawyer needed for the first interaction.
The numbers:
→ 2M+ legal cases resolved
→ 600,000+ vehicles protected
→ 99% resolution rate
→ ₹60Cr+ saved for fleet operators
But here's what excites me more than the metrics: we're proving that AI can work in low-trust, high-stakes domains — not just chatbots and content generation, but real decisions that affect people's livelihoods.
My AI thesis:
The next wave of AI isn't general-purpose assistants. It's vertical AI — deeply embedded in specific industries, trained on domain-specific data, solving problems that require regulatory and cultural context. India has unique opportunities here: legal-tech, agri-tech, healthcare, financial inclusion. The winners won't be those with the best models, but those with the best data moats and distribution.
What I do:
🔹 Build — CTO at Lawyered, architecting LAILA and LOTS247
🔹 Evaluate — CTO at India Accelerator, conducting technical due diligence on AI startups across 225+ portfolio companies (including unicorns like Ola)
🔹 Teach — Passionate about system design and helping engineers think architecturally
Previously: Director of Engineering at Delivery Hero (Singapore), Senior EM at Classplus (scaled to 4Cr+ DAUs), Software Consultant at McKinsey.
Background: MTech in Data Science & ML (BITS Pilani) | Deep Learning & TensorFlow Specializations
I write about: Applied AI in India, vertical AI opportunities, what separates AI startups that scale from those that don't, and lessons from evaluating 100+ tech startups.
DM me about: AI startup evaluation, legal-tech, scaling AI in production, architecture reviews.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Over the last few years, influencer marketing campaigns for brands have largely been managed by agencies. Typically, these campaigns are run manually on emails, phone calls and excel sheets. And they work just fine, to an extent. The problem arises when these campaigns need to be scaled and repeated frequently. That is when shit hits the fan and things fall apart. Influencers are not shortlisted based on data but on subjective opinions. Content briefs are incomplete and that results in sub-par content being created. Posts don't go up on time. And all along, the brand has no view on how the campaign is performing.If for a moment we step back and break down the campaign execution process, it comprises more than 90% of redundant tasks that can be automated. Right from shortlisting influencers, creating and sharing content briefs, post reminders, payments, and performance tracking. By simply automating these tasks, the effectiveness of a campaign can increase by up to 4x in less than one-third of the time and effort. This is when the full potential of content creators & influencers and the concept of influencer marketing fully gets realized.This is what Winkl has set out to do. We believe that by leveraging technology in the right places, influencer marketing as a channel can become highly repeatable and scalable for brands and advertisers of all sizes.Winkl helps brands and advertisers run fully automated and data-driven influencer marketing campaigns by leveraging a community of more than 33,000 active influencers with a reach of 150 million people in India.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Over the last few years, influencer marketing campaigns for brands have largely been managed by agencies. Typically, these campaigns are run manually on emails, phone calls and excel sheets. And they work just fine, to an extent. The problem arises when these campaigns need to be scaled and repeated frequently. That is when shit hits the fan and things fall apart. Influencers are not shortlisted based on data but on subjective opinions. Content briefs are incomplete and that results in sub-par content being created. Posts don't go up on time. And all along, the brand has no view on how the campaign is performing.If for a moment we step back and break down the campaign execution process, it comprises more than 90% of redundant tasks that can be automated. Right from shortlisting influencers, creating and sharing content briefs, post reminders, payments, and performance tracking. By simply automating these tasks, the effectiveness of a campaign can increase by up to 4x in less than one-third of the time and effort. This is when the full potential of content creators & influencers and the concept of influencer marketing fully gets realized.This is what Winkl has set out to do. We believe that by leveraging technology in the right places, influencer marketing as a channel can become highly repeatable and scalable for brands and advertisers of all sizes.Winkl helps brands and advertisers run fully automated and data-driven influencer marketing campaigns by leveraging a community of more than 33,000 active influencers with a reach of 150 million people in India.
